cadenas.Abrillantado de piso de mármol con pulid: Floor polishing of marble with polishing mechanical and crystallized. Includes the polishing, the crystallized and the polishing final. Measured per square meter polishing.
cadenas.Acabado de fachada aislada con mortero d: Finishing of an insulated facade with a protective render and mesh, ready for the final coating.
Rendered finish to an insulated facade.
cadenas.Acabado de juntas y remates de un trasdo: Joint finish and finishings of to lining of gypsum board already installed, as work independent. Includes the touching up of the joints with compound and tape, the masillado of heads of screw, the sanding of the joints and the junction finishing with walls and ceiling. Measured per square meter of surface treated.
cadenas.Acabado de superficie de concreto estruc: Finishing of the surface of structural concrete. Includes troweling and finishing. Measured per square meter finished.
cadenas.Acabado decorativo tipo estuco veneciano: Decorative finish type Venetian plaster to the lime, applied in several layers to trowel on interior face prepared, with burnishing final that produces the gloss characteristic. Es to finish work puro in the that the result depends almost by complete of the coat of the aplicador, by what conviene ejecutar to sample prior aprobada by the client before of acometer the bay. Includes the preparation and sealing of the substrate, the application of the layers successive with the trowel, the burnishing and the encerado final of protection. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Acabado superficial de la losa mediante: Surface finish of the slab by power troweling and its subsequent curing. Includes the initial screeding and floating, power troweling in as many passes as are needed to obtain the texture required according to whether it is to receive an adhered floor or to be left exposed, saw cutting the shrinkage joints at the right moment, and curing with a curing membrane or continuous watering over the first few days, without which the slab cracks by plastic shrinkage however well it has been poured. Measured by the area actually finished.
Finishing and curing of a foundation slab.
cadenas.Acabado y curado de losa de fundación. I: Finishing and curing of a mat foundation. Includes troweling and curing. Measured per square meter constructed.
cadenas.Accesorio de baño (toallero, jabonera, e: Bathroom accessory, such as a towel rail or soap dish.
cadenas.Acera de concreto de 8 cm sobre base com: Concrete sidewalk 8 cm thick on a compacted base, with control joints and a non-slip finish, with the cross fall for drainage. Includes setting out levels and falls, the perimeter formwork, placing the mesh, pouring and screeding, the finish, saw cutting or forming the control joints at the spacing indicated and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Aceras, brocales, rampas y escaleras ext: Steels, frames, ramps and exterior stairs
cadenas.Achique de agua en excavación con bomba: Dewatering of an excavation with a submersible pump. Includes placing the pump and dewatering. Measured per cubic meter pumped out.
Irrigation service connection with a shut-off valve.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica desde el punto de su: Electrical service from the supply point.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica provisional de obra: Temporary electrical supply for the works, with a distribution panel.
Temporary electrical supply for the works with a distribution panel. Includes running the cable and the panel. Measured per supply actually installed.
Temporary electrical supply for the works.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica subterránea. Incluye: Service connection electrical underground. Includes the laying and the connection. Measured per service connection completed.
cadenas.Acometida provisional de agua de obra. I: Temporary water supply for the works. Includes connecting to the main and the main stop valve. Measured per supply actually installed.
Storage of debris in stacked sacks.

cadenas.Acopio provisional de tierra en obra par: Temporary stockpiling of soil on site for reuse.
cadenas.Acopio y reutilización de tierra en obra: Stockpiling and reuse of soil on site.
cadenas.Adecuación de foso de ascensor. Incluye: Adaptation of elevator pit. Includes the preparation of the pit. Measured per unit suitable.
cadenas.Adecuación de hueco para ascensor. Inclu: Adaptation of opening for elevator. Includes the preparation of the opening. Measured per unit suitable.
cadenas.Adecuación de zona de vestuario y comedo: Fitting out of a site changing and canteen area, with furniture and basic services.
Fitting out of a changing and canteen area.
Air source heat pump for domestic hot water.
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto aligerado con anime: Concrete sub-base hollow-core with EPS as fill, for leveling of floors. Includes the field layout, the concrete placing and the leveling. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto de 8 cm de espesor: Concrete sub-base of 8 cm of thickness with welded wire mesh of shrinkage, concrete placing on stone base chipping compacted and vapor barrier, with joints of control aserradas. Includes the checking of the base, the installation of the vapor barrier and of the mesh on spacers, the concrete placing and vibration, the screeding level, the floating, the sawing of the joints of control in the moment suitable, that es what prevents the cracking haphazard by shrinkage, and the curing. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto sobre terreno, 8 cm: 8 cm concrete bed on the ground.
cadenas.Afirmado de mortero de cemento y arena d: Mortar sub-base of cement and sand of 4 cm of thickness mean, screeding and screeding, completed on slab or base compacted to receive the finish floor. Es the layer that define the level and the flatness permanents of the floor, so that the defects that are left here are dragged to all the subsequent finish. Includes the cleaning and dampened of the substrate, the installation of furring channels to the project level, the laying and screeding of the mortar, the floating of the surface and the curing during the first days. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Agotamiento del agua acumulada en la exc: Dewatering of water accumulated in the excavation with a submersible pump and discharge hose to an authorized point, to allow the work to be carried out in the dry. It applies where groundwater, seepage or accumulated rainwater is encountered. Includes siting the pump at the low point, running the discharge hose to a point where the discharge will neither erode nor flood other areas, monitoring the operation, periodic cleaning of the suction strainer and removal of the equipment. Measured per hour of actual operation of the equipment.
Acoustic insulation of a party wall.

cadenas.Aislamiento de piso sobre cámara sanitar: Insulation of a floor over a crawl space.
cadenas.Aislamiento de puente térmico en vigas o: Insulation of a thermal bridge at beams or columns, with polystyrene boards. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Insulation of thermal bridges at beams.
cadenas.Aislamiento de servicio de gas existente: Isolation of the existing gas service.
cadenas.Aislamiento de techo de entrepiso no aco: Insulation of the roof over an unconditioned intermediate floor.
Insulation of a roof between joists.
cadenas.Aislamiento del servicio de gas existent: Isolation of the existing gas service, by shutting off and temporarily capping the line. Includes closing the gas valve and capping it securely. Measured per service isolated.
cadenas.Aislamiento reflectivo de techo metálico: Reflective insulation to a metal roof.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico bajo losa de fundaci: Thermal insulation beneath a foundation slab.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico bajo techo inclinado: Thermal insulation beneath a pitched roof.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de conducto de clima: Thermal insulation of an HVAC duct.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta con lana: Thermal insulation of a roof deck with mineral wool.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta con pane: Thermal insulation of a roof deck with sandwich panels.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta plana co: Thermal insulation of a flat roof with polystyrene.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta transita: Thermal insulation of a trafficable roof deck.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cámara de aire co: Thermal insulation of an air cavity with a reflective layer.
Thermal insulation of a water tank.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de fachada con panel: Thermal insulation of a facade with sandwich panels.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de fachada por el ex: External thermal insulation of a facade.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de losa con poliesti: Thermal insulation of a slab with polystyrene.

cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de muro con poliesti: Thermal insulation of a wall with extruded polystyrene.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de muro por el inter: Internal thermal insulation of a wall.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de piso con poliesti: Thermal insulation of a floor with polystyrene.
Thermal insulation of a radiant floor heating system.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de tabique con doble: Thermal insulation of a partition with a double panel.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de techo con poliest: Thermal insulation of a roof with polystyrene.
Thermal insulation to a roof deck.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico reflectivo bajo cubi: Reflective thermal insulation beneath a roof.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico reflectivo en fachad: Reflective thermal insulation on a facade.
cadenas.Ajuste de portón corredizo, con reajuste: Adjustment of a sliding gate, re-adjusting the carriers, guides and stops. Includes checking and re-adjusting. Measured per unit adjusted.
cadenas.Ajuste de puerta descolgada o que roza,: Adjustment of a door that has dropped or is binding, by re-adjusting the hinges. Includes checking and re-adjusting the hardware. Measured per unit adjusted.
Adjustment of a door that has dropped on its hinges.
Eaves of a metal sheet roof.
Eaves and edge trim of a roof.
cadenas.Alféizares, vierteaguas, pasamanos y cor: Sills, sill flashing, handrail and copings
cadenas.Alisado de paramento con pasta de nivela: Smoothing of a surface with leveling compound.
cadenas.Alisado de paramento existente mediante: Face troweling existing by application of compound of leveling to trowel, to correct irregularities smaller, roller frames, textured coating fine or finish debris previous, leaving the flat surface. Es the alternativa economic to the chipping and refriso when the face is sound but with texture or defects surfaces. Includes the scraping of the parts loose, the application of the undercoat fixative, the spreading of the compound in to or two coats according to the defect to correct, the sanding with suction and the touching up final. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².

cadenas.Alquiler de contenedor de residuos mezcl: Hire of a container for mixed non-recoverable waste, including delivery and collection for landfill.
cadenas.Alquiler de contenedor destinado a chata: Hire of a container for scrap metal, including delivery and collection for handover to the waste carrier.
cadenas.Alquiler de contenedor destinado a resid: Hire of a container for lumber waste, including delivery and collection for recycling.
cadenas.Alquiler mensual de baño químico portáti: Monthly hire of a portable chemical toilet, including its maintenance and cleaning.
cadenas.Alquiler mensual de contenedor de escomb: Monthly hire of a 3 m³ debris container, including delivery and collection by the waste carrier.
Extension of a slab as a cantilever or balcony.
cadenas.Ampliación de losa existente en voladizo: Extension of an existing slab as a cantilever or the formation of a balcony, tied into the structure by chemically anchoring the continuity bars. The connection is the critical point: a cantilever works with the steel in the top face and with the full anchorage length within the existing slab, so the depth and the position of the holes admit no approximation. Includes shoring, hacking back and cleaning the existing edge, drilling and chemically anchoring the bars, the reinforcement, the formwork on shores, pouring and vibrating, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Anchoring of a bar with epoxy resin.
cadenas.Anclaje de barra de acero en elemento de: Anchoring of a steel bar into an existing concrete element with two-component epoxy resin injected into the hole, to connect new elements to the existing structure. Includes setting out the point and avoiding the existing reinforcement by scanning beforehand, drilling to the diameter and depth specified by the resin manufacturer, cleaning the hole by repeated blowing out and brushing, the operation on which the capacity of the anchor depends entirely and the one most often skipped on site, injecting the resin from the bottom, inserting the bar with a twisting motion and respecting the curing time before loading it. Measured per unit actually constructed.
cadenas.Anclaje de estructura de techo a la losa: Anchoring of a roof structure to the slab.
cadenas.Anclaje químico de barra de acero en con: Chemical anchoring of a steel bar in concrete.
Chemical anchoring of a bar in concrete.
cadenas.Anclaje químico o mecánico de la estruct: Chemical or mechanical anchoring of the roof structure to the slab or supporting beam, with anchor bolts. Includes drilling and fixing.
cadenas.Andamio colgante o silleta para trabajos: Swing stage for work on a facade.
cadenas.Andamio colgante para trabajos en fachad: Swing stage for work on a facade.
cadenas.Andamio interior móvil o sobre borriquet: Mobile scaffold or trestle scaffold indoors.
cadenas.Andamio interior rodante o plataforma so: Mobile indoor scaffold or trestle platform for work at height indoors, such as ceilings, plaster on high walls and painting. Includes delivery of the equipment to site, its erection and leveling, the installation of guardrails where the working height requires it, successive repositioning and height adjustment through the working day, dismantling and removal. Measured by the area of ceiling or wall surface actually reached from the scaffold.
cadenas.Andamio tubular de fachada con plataform: Tubular scaffold to a facade with working platforms.
cadenas.Andamio tubular de fachada, montaje, alq: Tubular scaffold to a facade, including erection, monthly hire and dismantling.
cadenas.Andamio tubular metálico apoyado en fach: Tubular steel scaffold bearing on the facade, with working platforms, guardrails, toe boards and an internal access stair, including its erection, the first month on hire and its dismantling. Includes the prior assessment of the bearing and of the ties to the facade, erection by competent personnel, the installation of the collective protective measures, inspection of the whole assembly before it is brought into service and after any modification, orderly dismantling and removal of the material. It does not include hire beyond the first month, which is priced in the following item. Measured by the area of facade actually covered by the scaffold.
cadenas.Apeo de cubierta o techo durante trabajo: Shoring of a roof during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a lintel while an opening is formed.
cadenas.Apeo de dintel durante la apertura de va: Shoring of a lintel while the opening is formed. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring to the formwork of a beam.
cadenas.Apeo de escalera existente durante traba: Shoring of an existing stair during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de fachada durante demolición parci: Shoring of a facade during partial demolition.
Shoring of a facade during partial demolition. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con puntales metálicos y du: Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams.
Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with shores and spreader beams.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con torres de carga metálic: Shoring of a slab with steel load towers. Includes erecting the towers. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with load towers.
Shoring of a beam with steel shores.
cadenas.Apeo de viga con puntales metálicos. Inc: Shoring of a beam with steel shores. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring of a beam with shores.
cadenas.Apeo o arriostramiento provisional de mu: Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall using raking shores with spreader beams, to stabilize it against thrust or overturning while work goes on around it. Must follow the instruction of the engineer or architect in charge. Includes setting out the bearing points, preparing the spreader bases on the floor, erecting and loading the raking shores, periodically checking stability and tightness, and dismantling once the element has been made good. Measured over the area of wall actually shored.
Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall.
cadenas.Apeo provisional de losa mediante puntal: Temporary shoring of a slab with telescopic steel shores on spreader beams at head and base, to support the structure while demolition, openings or strengthening are carried out. It must be carried out to a calculation or to the express instruction of the responsible professional, who defines the spacing and the load on the shores. Includes field layout of the shoring grid, placing the spreader beams, erecting and loading the shores without forcing the structure, checking plumb and bearing, maintenance and inspection during the works, and the staged removal of the shoring once the specified strength has been reached. Measured by the area of slab actually shored.
cadenas.Apeo provisional de viga mediante puntal: Temporary shoring of a beam with telescopic steel shores and a spreader beam at the head, placed on both sides of the element being worked on. It must be carried out to a calculation or to the instruction of the responsible professional. Includes field layout of the shoring points, placing the spreader beams, erecting and progressively loading the shores, checking that the load is transferred to a bearing of sufficient capacity at the level below, inspection during the works and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the length of beam actually shored.
cadenas.Apeo y soporte de encofrado de viga. Inc: Shoring and support to the formwork of a beam. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pa: Exploratory opening in a wall, roughly 30x30 cm, to identify the type of substrate, its thickness or the presence of concealed services before the work is designed. Includes scanning beforehand with an electronic detector so as not to drill into a live pipe or cable, carefully breaking out layer by layer until the element being sought is exposed, photographic recording of what is found, and patching the opening with repair mortar so the face is left ready for its finish. Measured per opening actually carried out.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pi: Exploratory opening in a floor or slab, roughly 40x40 cm, to identify the thickness and condition of the sub-base, whether waterproofing is present, or whether services are buried below, before the work is defined. Includes scanning beforehand with a detector, cutting around the perimeter with a disc saw for a clean edge, breaking out layer by layer and recording the thickness of each, photographic recording, and reinstating the opening with repair mortar finished flush with the existing level. cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de fachada c: Application of facade covering with mortar decorative acrylic and watertight. Includes the substrate preparation and the application of the mortar acrylic. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de poliureta: Application of polyurethane covering two-component on floor interior, with primer and two layers. Includes the substrate preparation, the primer and the two polyurethane layers. Measured per square meter coated.
Application of polyurethane covering cement-based on floor, resistant to the abrasion. Includes the preparation and the application of the covering. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de resina ac: Application of resin covering decorative acrylic on floor or face. Includes the preparation and the application of the resin. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de resina co: Application of resin covering with aggregate of quartz colored slip-resistant on floor. Includes the preparation, the resin and the espolvoreo of the quartz. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de resina en: Application of resin covering in chamber refrigeration or local cold. Includes the preparation and the application of the covering suitable for cold. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento decorativo t: Application of decorative covering textured on face, with finish to choice. Includes the substrate preparation and the application of the textured. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento elastomérico: Application of covering elastomeric waterproofing in facade, in two or three coats up to reach the thickness of film that guarantees the puenteo of cracks. To difference of to paint conventional, its value is in the thickness: applied in fine layer for ahorrar material loses the elasticidad that justifica its precio and leaves of puentear the cracks. Includes the substrate preparation, the prior treatment of cracks larger with band, the application of the coats cross observing the consumption indicated by the manufacturer and the verification of the thickness. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico anti: Application of covering epoxy slip-resistant on floor interior or exterior, with layer of primer and finish with aggregate. Includes the preparation, the primer and the finish slip-resistant. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico auto: Application of covering epoxy autodrenante on floor industrial, with slope of discharge. Includes the preparation, the primer and the finish autodrenante. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico cond: Application of covering epoxy conductor antistatic on laboratory floor or industria electronics. Includes the preparation and the application of the covering conductor. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico deco: Application of covering decorative epoxy with flakes of color on floor or face. Includes the preparation, the primer and the application with flakes. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico en p: Application of covering epoxy in kitchen face industrial, resistant to greases and cleaning. Includes the preparation and the application. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento reflectivo s: Application of covering reflective on roof, to reduce the thermal loading. Includes the cleaning and the application of the covering reflective. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de revestimiento epóxico de a: Application of coating epoxy high-strength chemical on floor or laboratory face or industria. Includes the preparation, the primer and the finish layers resistants to products chemicals. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de sellador hidrofugante y an: Application of sealer water-repellent and stain-resistant on floor or stone tiling natural. Includes the prior cleaning and the application of the sealer protective. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de tinte o colorante para mad: Application of tinte or colorante for lumber interior, with to or two coats. Includes the preparation of the lumber and the application of the tinte. Measured per square meter stained.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento anticarbónico: Application of treatment anti-carbonation or facade protective. Includes the prior cleaning and the application. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento anticorrosivo: Application of anti-corrosion treatment to a metal roof, with cleaning beforehand and two coats. Includes preparation of the surface.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento fitosanitario: Application of pest and disease treatment to a planted area. Includes application.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento ignífugo sobre: Application of a fire-retardant treatment to a wood structure on site, to improve its fire resistance.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento preservante fu: Application of fungicidal and insecticidal preservative to structural lumber, in two coats by brush or by dipping. In a tropical climate this treatment is not optional: unprotected lumber has a short service life against termites and rot fungi. Includes sanding and cleaning the surface beforehand, applying the first coat with particular attention to the end grain, the joints and the bearing areas, which carry the greatest risk, respecting the absorption time and applying the second coat. Measured by the area actually treated, taking every face.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de estructura de techo ex: Shoring of an existing roof structure.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de losa durante el vaciad: Shoring of a slab during the pour and curing.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de losa mediante puntales: Shoring of a slab with telescopic steel shores on spreader beams, sized to carry the weight of the wet concrete, of the formwork and of the construction loads, and kept in place until the slab reaches the specified strength. Premature removal of the shoring is one of the most frequent causes of excessive deflection and permanent cracking. Includes setting out the grid, placing spreader beams at head and base, erecting and loading the shores, checking that the load is transferred to a level below of sufficient capacity, inspection during the pour and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area of slab actually shored.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de muro con madera y punt: Shoring of a wall with lumber and shores. Includes installing the shoring. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a wall with lumber.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de talud o excavación int: Shoring of an internal slope or excavation. Includes installing the trench sheeting. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de vano durante la apertu: Shoring of an opening while it is formed.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento provisional de estructura: Temporary shoring of a roof structure during repair, with steel shores and spreader beams. Includes erection and dismantling.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento provisional del muro situ: Temporary shoring of the wall over an opening that is to be formed or widened, using shores and spreader beams that carry the load of the masonry above while the demolition is carried out and the permanent lintel is placed. This is what stops the masonry collapsing when its support is removed. Includes setting out, cutting the bearing pockets for the spreader beam into the wall, erecting and loading the shores on both faces, checking them during the demolition, removing the shoring once the permanent lintel has cured and taken load, and patching the bearing pockets. Measured per opening actually shored.

cadenas.Automatización de portón corredizo exist: Automation of an existing sliding gate.

Automation of an awning with a solar sensor.

cadenas.Automatización de un portón corredizo ex: Automation of an existing sliding gate, with motor, control and limit switches. Includes fitting the motor and the programming. Measured per unit automated.

cadenas.Bajada de escombro desde plantas altas h: Removal of debris from upper floors to the storage or loading point, by hoist, hopper or by hand, depending on access at the site. It is a cost that is consistently forgotten, and in a building without a site hoist it can exceed the cost of disposal itself. Includes bagging the debris, moving it to the point of descent, lowering it by the means available, stacking it neatly at ground level and the continuous cleaning of the common circulation areas, which in an occupied building is mandatory and takes real time. Measured by the volume of bulked debris actually removed.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro desde plantas altas m: Removal of debris from upper floors through a debris chute or vertical duct, with a receiving hopper and water spray for dust control.
Removal of debris from upper floors by site hoist, with loading and unloading by hand.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro desde plantas altas p: Removal of debris from upper floors by hand in sacks, to the storage area at ground floor level.
Removal of debris from upper floors.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro por escombrera o duct: Removal of debris through a debris chute.

Wood guardrail for an interior balcony.
cadenas.Baranda de madera para escalera interior: Wood guardrail for an interior stair.
cadenas.Baranda de protección en perímetro de lo: Guardrail around the perimeter of a slab.
cadenas.Baranda provisional de protección en bor: Temporary guardrail at the edges of slabs, openings, stairways and voids, with posts, a top rail, a mid rail and a toe board. It is the collective measure that prevents falls from height, the leading cause of serious accidents on site. It must be erected before the risk arises, not afterwards. Includes erecting the guardrail system with its fixings, installing the top rail, mid rail and toe board that stops material falling, periodic inspection of the assembly and its removal once the permanent protection is in place. Measured by the length actually protected.
Facade guardrail with a protective barrier.
cadenas.Barnizado de barandas y pasamanos de mad: Railing varnishing and wood handrail, with sanding and two varnish coats. Includes the preparation of the surface and the two varnish coats. Measured per square meter varnishing.
Varnishing of lumber guardrails and handrails.
cadenas.Barnizado de mueble de madera exterior,: Cabinet varnishing of lumber exterior, with sanding and two varnish coats marino. Includes the preparation and the two varnish coats. Measured per square meter varnishing.
cadenas.Barnizado de puerta de madera interior,: Door varnishing of lumber interior, with sanding and two varnish coats. Includes the preparation and the two varnish coats. Measured per square meter varnishing.
Grab bar in a shower or bathtub.
cadenas.Barrera anticapilaridad en arranque de m: Damp-proof course at the base of a wall.
cadenas.Barrera antipolvo con lámina plástica y: Dust barrier in plastic sheeting with an access opening.
Vapor barrier beneath a roof deck.
Vapor barrier beneath a foundation slab.
cadenas.Barrera de vapor de polietileno bajo los: Polyethylene vapor barrier beneath a foundation slab.
cadenas.Barrera provisional de confinamiento de: Temporary dust containment barrier between the work area and the areas still in use, made up of a lumber batten frame with polyethylene sheeting stretched and sealed around its whole perimeter against floor, walls and ceiling, with a zip door for access. This is what allows work to go on in one room while the rest of the building stays occupied and operating. Includes setting out, erecting the frame, fitting and sealing the sheeting, fitting the access opening, maintaining the barrier while the works last, and dismantling and removing it at the end. Measured over the area of barrier actually erected.
cadenas.Base continua de mortero de cemento sobr: Continuous cement mortar bed over the roof slope to receive tiling or sheeting, with reinforcing mesh at the junctions. Includes spreading, screeding and finishing.
Compacted sand base beneath paving. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
Concrete base for a gate post.
Mortar base for a tile roof.
cadenas.Base de piedra picada compactada para pa: Compacted crushed stone base for paving.
Compacted crushed stone base for paving. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
cadenas.Base de piedra picada extendida y compac: Crushed stone base spread and compacted beneath floors, sidewalks or external paving, acting as a drainage and load spreading layer and breaking the capillary rise of moisture into the floor. Includes supply and placing of the stone, spreading it in 15 cm layers, blinding with fine material where the surface has to be closed, compaction with a plate compactor and checking the final level and regularity. Measured by the volume of compacted base to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Baño portátil de obra, por mes de perman: Portable site toilet, per month on site.
Shadow gap in a suspended ceiling.
cadenas.Borde perimetral de sombra para iluminac: Perimeter shadow gap for indirect lighting.
Edge and parapet of a flat roof.
Medicine cabinet with an integrated mirror.
cadenas.Cabezal de concreto armado de resistenci: Reinforced concrete pile cap of 250 kg/cm² strength that receives the load of the column and distributes it across the group of piles, including its formwork, pouring, vibration and curing. Includes setting out over the cut-off heads, erecting and bracing the formwork, checking that the starter bars from the piles are embedded with the anchorage length specified, pouring in layers with vibration, stripping and curing. It does not include the reinforcement, which is priced by weight. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Cajón de persiana en dintel con registro: Roller shutter box in a lintel, with an access panel.

Drainage channel with a metal grille.
Linear drainage channel with a grille.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica con conductor de: Electrical conduit with conductor of 10 AWG. Includes the laying of the conductor. Measured per linear meter installed.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica dedicada para equ: Electrical conduit dedicada for unit of air conditioning, with its pipe, gauge conductor suitable and provision of the protection independent in the board. Includes the field layout of the route between the board and the unit, the chase opening or the laying by plenum, the laying of the conductor sizing to the power of the unit, the passage to the unit exterior with its sealing of the passage in facade and the identification of the circuit. Measured in length actually installed.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica empotrada con con: Concealed electrical conduit, 20 mm, with 12 AWG conductor.
Electrical conduit recessed with conduit. Includes the laying of the conduit. Measured per linear meter installed.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica en cielo raso o s: Electrical conduit in a suspended ceiling or surface mounted.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica no empotrada, ten: Electrical conduit no recessed, laying by the plenum of the suspended ceiling or exposed on surface with pipe conduit and its clamps, with copper conductor. Facing the recessed conduit prevents the chipping and the patching, and leaves the installation accessible, what the makes preferible in renovation always that the layout remains concealed. Includes the field layout, the fastening of the pipe with clamps to the separation indicated, the laying of the conductors, the identification of circuits and the boxes of branch in points accessibles. Measured in length actually installed.
cadenas.Canalón de recogida en cubierta metálica: Collection gutter on a metal roof.
Concealed gutter beneath a tile eaves.
Landfill tipping fee for mixed debris.

cadenas.Capa de acabado fino de pasta aplicada s: Finish layer fine of compound applied on mortar stucco or of gypsum, of 2 to 3 mm of thickness, to obtain to surface tersa suitable for paints of high gloss or for finishes where any irregularidad is marked with the light ground level. Includes the checking and the prior sealing of the substrate, the application of the compound in two coats cross with trowel, the sanding between coats and the sanding final with suction, and the review with light ground level to detect and correct the defects that only appear low esa lighting. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Capa de compresión de cubierta con malla: Structural topping to a roof deck with mesh.
cadenas.Capa de compresión de mortero armado con: Reinforced mortar structural topping with welded wire mesh over lightweight roof fill, to spread loads. Includes spreading, embedding the mesh and floating.
cadenas.Capa de concreto pobre de limpieza de 5: Mud slab of 5 cm average thickness, poured over the bottom of the excavation before the footing is reinforced. It serves a purpose of execution rather than a structural one: it separates the steel from the ground, stops soil contaminating the structural concrete and gives a clean level surface on which to set out and stand the spacers. Includes going over and compacting the bottom, pouring and spreading the concrete, screeding it level and marking the center lines of the footing on the hardened slab. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Capa de mortero de protección sobre el a: Protective mortar screed over the roof insulation, before the waterproofing, to give support and continuity. Includes spreading and floating.
cadenas.Capa de mortero de protección sobre la i: Protective mortar screed over the waterproofing of a flat roof, reinforced with mesh and with shrinkage joints, protecting the membrane from traffic and from radiation. It must be laid on a separating layer: if it is poured directly onto the waterproofing, the shrinkage of the mortar drags on the membrane and tears it. Includes laying the separating sheet, the shrinkage mesh, pouring and screeding the mortar, forming shrinkage joints in bays and against the parapets, floating and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Capa de nivelación con mortero seco de c: Layer of leveling with mortar dry of earth consistency damp, spreading and compacted, empleada when there is that salvar unevenness importantes or embeber installations low the floor without recurrir to to thickness of mortar conventional that would be costoso and heavy. Includes the cleaning of the substrate, the level field layout with furring channels, the spreading and compacted of the mortar by layers, the screeding final and the application of the shut-off grout surface that sella the layer and allows receive the adhesive of the floor. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
Drainage layer with a dimpled membrane.
Drainage layer of a green roof.
cadenas.Capa separadora de geotextil en cubierta: Geotextile separating layer on a roof deck.
Geotextile separating layer on a terrace.
Air terminal on a chimney for lightning protection.

cadenas.Carga manual de escombro sobre contenedo: Hand loading of debris into a container or vehicle, using shovels and sacks, for removal.
Hand loading of debris into a container.
cadenas.Carga manual de tierra sobrante a carret: Hand loading of surplus spoil into a wheelbarrow or sack. Includes loading. Measured per cubic meter loaded.
cadenas.Carga manual del material sobrante de ex: Hand loading of surplus excavated material onto a dump truck and cartage to a licensed spoil site, including the tipping fee, based on an average distance of 25 km. It is used where the stockpile cannot be reached by loading plant. Includes loading onto the vehicle by shovel, sheeting and securing the load to prevent spillage in transit, cartage, tipping and cleaning of the loading area. Measured by the volume of bulked material actually removed.
cadenas.Carga manual y transporte de tierra sobr: Hand loading and cartage of surplus spoil to a spoil site.
cadenas.Carga mecanizada de tierra sobrante a ca: Mechanical loading of surplus spoil onto a truck. Includes loading. Measured per cubic meter loaded.
cadenas.Carga mecanizada del material sobrante d: Mechanical loading of surplus excavated material with a backhoe onto a dump truck and cartage to a licensed spoil site, including the tipping fee, based on an average distance of 25 km. Includes loading with the machine, sheeting and securing the load, cartage, tipping, hand trimming of the residual stockpile and cleaning of the loading area. Measured by the volume of bulked material actually removed.
cadenas.Carga mecanizada y transporte de tierra: Mechanical loading and cartage of surplus spoil to a spoil site.
cadenas.Carga mecánica de escombro sobre vehícul: Mechanical loading of debris onto a vehicle or dump truck with suitable equipment, for removal to landfill.
Mechanical loading of debris onto a vehicle.

Store or enclosed area for materials, per month. Includes erection and the period on site. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Cata en muro para reconocimiento de espe: Exploratory opening in a wall to check its thickness and makeup. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per linear meter of opening.

cadenas.Cata en pared para reconocimiento de ins: Exploratory opening in a wall to identify services or substrate.
cadenas.Cata en piso o losa para reconocimiento: Exploratory opening in a floor or slab to identify layers or services.
cadenas.Cata en techo o cara inferior de losa pa: Exploratory opening in a ceiling or the underside of a slab to inspect the structure. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per linear meter of opening.
cadenas.Cata en techo para reconocimiento de los: Exploratory opening in a ceiling to inspect the slab.
cadenas.Cata para localización de tubería enterr: Exploratory opening to locate a buried pipe.
Exploratory opening to locate a buried pipe. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per opening carried out.

cadenas.Cenefa o listelo decorativo en enchapado: Decorative border or listello in tiling.

Home automation controller with remote control.
Grille fence on a blockwork dwarf wall.
cadenas.Cerca perimetral de bloque de concreto c: Perimeter wall of concrete blocks with its confining piers and ring beam, rendered on both faces. Includes setting out the boundary line, constructing the strip footing, building the masonry level and plumb, the confining piers at the spacing specified, the ring beam, the render on both faces and the coping with a fall that sheds water and protects the top of the wall. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cerca perimetral de malla ciclónica con: Perimeter chain link fence with its posts, straining wires, barbed wire topping and concrete footings. Includes setting out the line, excavating and pouring the post footings, plumbing and bracing the corner and straining posts, which take all the tension of the mesh, running out and tensioning the mesh with its tie wire, fitting the straining wires and the topping. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Cerramiento de vano con lámina de madera: Closing off of an opening with a wood panel.
cadenas.Cerramiento perimetral provisional de ob: Temporary perimeter hoarding with warning mesh.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional de vano con lámi: Temporary closure of an opening with a wood panel.
Temporary closing off of an opening with a wood panel. Includes fixing the panel. Measured per square meter closed off.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional de vano de puert: Temporary closure of a door or window opening using a plywood or OSB panel on a batten frame, anchored into the opening. Used to close up voids left by demolition or by removing doors and windows, keeping the interior safe from the weather and from intruders until the permanent units arrive. Includes setting out and cutting the panel, building the frame, fixing it into the opening with anchors, sealing around the perimeter, maintaining it while the works last, and taking it down when the permanent units are fitted. Measured over the area of opening actually closed.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional del perímetro de: Temporary enclosure of the perimeter of the work area using plastic warning mesh on steel or lumber posts, with warning signs. It defines the work area and keeps unauthorized people out, a basic safety requirement where the works share the site with areas still in use or open onto common areas. Includes setting out, placing and bracing the posts, stretching and fixing the mesh, putting up the warning signs, maintaining it while the works last, and dismantling and removing it at the end. Measured over the length actually enclosed.
cadenas.Cerramientos, barreras de polvo y contro: Enclosures, dust barriers and control of accesses
cadenas.Cerámica y porcelanato en paredes: Ceramic and porcelain tile in walls
cadenas.Cielo desmontable con foseado perimetral: Suspended ceiling with a perimeter recess.
Suspended ceiling with a clip system.
cadenas.Cielo desmontable de alta absorción acús: Suspended ceiling with high acoustic absorption.
cadenas.Cielo desmontable de fibra con perfilerí: Mineral fiber suspended ceiling with a concealed grid.
cadenas.Cielo raso con láminas machihembradas de: Suspended ceiling with sheets tongue and grooves of PVC on battening or profiles, with finishing profiles perimeters. Es the solution economic and resistant to the damp more usada in areas of service, porches and bathrooms, with the advantage of that is cleaned with water and no is stained. Includes field layout and leveling, installation of the battening, installation of the perimeter profiles, installation of the sheets by fitting to pressure, the adjustment cuttings luminaire around and the finishing final. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso con machihembrado de madera s: Suspended ceiling with lumber tongue and groove on battening suspended of the slab, with chamber ventilated and treatment preservative. In climate tropical the ventilation of the chamber and the preservative in all the faces, including the ends, are what prevents the ataque of termite and the rot. cadenas.Colocación en pared de pieza de mármol o: Installation in piece wall of marble or granite in fine layer, with adhesive cement-based white high-performance. Includes the checking and leveling of the substrate, the field layout of the cutting list complying with to the vein and to the tone for that the composition continuous whether, the double gluing, the leveling, the cuttings with disc refrigerado, the grouting with joint minimum to matching and the cleaning with products no acids. Includes the checking and prior leveling of the flatness, the field layout of the cutting list, the double gluing, the leveling with shims, the cuttings with cortadora of disc refrigerada, the grouting and the cleaning final. cadenas.Concreto premezclado de resistencia 210: Ready-mixed concrete of 210 kg/cm² strength poured into a tie beam, including compaction by vibration and curing. The tie beam ties the footings together and is what absorbs differential settlement, so its continuity and the correct execution of the joints with the footings are decisive. Includes the prior check of the cage and of the cover, taking delivery of the concrete, pouring continuously to avoid cold joints at the connections, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding the top face and curing. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 210 kg/cm² strength poured into an isolated footing, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the formwork and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete on arrival and rejecting the load if the slump is not right, pouring in layers avoiding segregation, compacting with an internal vibrator without touching the cage or the formwork, screeding the top face, curing over the first few days and taking test cylinders where quality control requires it. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 210 kg/cm² strength poured into a strip footing under a wall or a line of columns, including compaction by vibration and curing. Pouring into a continuous trench gives a slightly better output than isolated footings because of the continuity of the working face. Includes the prior check of the cage and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring in layers, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding the top face to the level specified and curing over the first few days. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Concreto premezclado de resistencia 250: Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a column, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes cleaning the bottom of the formwork through the opening provided before closing it, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring in layers of limited height using a drop chute to avoid segregation from free fall, compacting each layer with an internal vibrator without touching the cage, striking off the head and leaving the surface rough for the joint with the beam above, stripping and curing. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a stair, including compaction by vibration and curing. Pouring on a slope needs a drier mix than usual so that it does not run down the flight, and it must be done working upwards from the foot. Includes the prior check of the formwork, the shoring and the cage, taking delivery of the concrete at the right slump, pouring upwards step by step, compacting with a vibrator, floating the treads and risers, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a mat foundation, including compaction by vibration. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the spacers and of the vapour barrier, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring continuously in bays avoiding cold joints, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding to level against screed rails and removing the bleed water before finishing. It does not include the surface finish or the curing, which are priced in the following item. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a solid intermediate floor or roof slab, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the formwork, of the shoring, of the cage and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring continuously in bays to avoid cold joints, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding to level against screed rails, floating the surface and curing over the first few days. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a retaining wall, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the formwork and of the cover, taking delivery of the concrete, pouring in layers of limited height and at alternate points so as not to rack the formwork, using a drop chute where the height of fall could cause segregation, compacting each layer with an internal vibrator, extended curing and stripping once the strength has been reached. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a structural wall, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the formwork and of the cover, taking delivery of the concrete, pouring in layers of limited height and at alternate points so as not to rack the formwork, using a drop chute to avoid segregation, compacting each layer with an internal vibrator, extended curing and stripping once the strength has been reached. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a bored pile, placed by tremie pipe or hopper with a drop tube. Includes checking that the bottom is clean and that the cage is in position, taking delivery of the concrete at a consistency that allows it to be placed without vibration over the full depth, pouring continuously from the bottom upwards without interruptions that would cause discontinuities, comparing the volume actually placed against the theoretical as an indicator of possible overbreak or losses, and overpouring the head to displace the contaminated concrete. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design diameter and length.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a beam, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the shoring and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring continuously to avoid cold joints and respecting the position of the construction joints specified in the middle third of the span, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding the top face, curing and the staged removal of the shoring once the strength has been reached. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

cadenas.Construcción de jardinera de obra en ext: Construction of a planter externally, with its masonry, render, internal waterproofing, drainage and filter layer. A planter without waterproofing and without drainage transmits permanent moisture to the adjoining wall and waterlogs the soil until the roots rot, so both layers are part of the element and not an extra. Includes the footing, building the masonry, the external render, the internal waterproofing with reinforcement at the junctions, the sleeve and the drainage pipe, the gravel layer with geotextile and the capping. The growing medium and the planting are not included. Measured by the length of planter.
cadenas.Construcción de tanquilla o registro de: Construction of a drainage inspection chamber in masonry or concrete, with its base slab, rendered walls, cover and connections. Includes excavation, pouring the base slab with the benching that guides the flow and prevents siltation, building the walls, the waterproofed internal render, connecting the inlet and outlet pipes at their levels and gradients, setting the frame and cover flush with the paving and the flow test. Measured per unit constructed.
cadenas.Construcción o instalación de registro d: Construction or installation of water inspection chamber served in the red of drain, with its ground slab with average cane, walls, cover airtight and connections. The inspection chamber must situarse in the changes of direction and in the sections longs, because es the single point by where can be desobstruir the red without break floor. Includes the excavation, the ground slab with the average cane of pipeline that guide the flow and prevents the sedimentation, the wall survey, the stucco interior waterproofed, the connections with its levels and the cover airtight level of floor. Measured per unit completed.

cadenas.Cristalizado y abrillantado de piso de p: Crystallized and floor polishing of stone natural or granite, to recover the gloss and the protection surface. Includes the polishing mechanical with abrasivos and the polishing final. Measured per square meter polishing.
Crystallization and buffing of a stone floor.
cadenas.Cubierta con lámina metálica acanalada g: Roof covering of galvanised or prefinished corrugated metal sheet, fixed to the purlins with self-drilling screws and neoprene washers. The screw must be tightened until the washer is compressed without deforming the sheet: overtightened, the washer degrades and leaks; undertightened, it does not seal. Includes setting out the side and end laps against the prevailing wind, placing and aligning the sheets, fixing on the crown of the corrugation, sealing the laps and the eaves, ridge and edge finishings. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta con panel sándwich de doble cha: Roof covering of sandwich panels with two metal faces and a polyurethane insulating core, fixed to the purlins with purpose-made fasteners and sealed tongue and groove joints. It resolves the covering, the thermal insulation and the internal finish in a single operation, which offsets its higher material cost against plain sheeting with separate insulation. Includes setting out, hoisting and placing the panels with the joints engaged, sealing the joints, fixing and the ridge, eaves and edge finishings with purpose-made units. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta con teja asfáltica tipo shingle: Roof covering of asphalt shingles nailed to a continuous deck over asphalt felt. It needs a continuous firm deck, not simply battens, because an asphalt shingle has no stiffness of its own and follows every irregularity in the substrate. Includes laying the felt with laps, setting out the courses, nailing the shingles with the number and position of nails the manufacturer specifies, since wind resistance depends on it, forming the ridges with purpose-made units and the edge finishes with metal trim. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta con teja criolla de arcilla coc: Roof covering of fired clay barrel tiles on battens or a continuous bed, bedded in mortar at the eaves, ridges and edges and laid dry on the slope. Includes setting out the courses so that the closing tile is not cut, laying the pan and cover tiles with the lap the gradient requires, bedding the edge tiles in mortar, which are the ones the wind lifts, forming the ridges and hips and the final clean. Measured by the area actually constructed.

cadenas.Ejecución del salpicadero o zócalo poste: Construction of the backsplash or upstand to the countertop, in the same material as the top or in the finish chosen, with the bottom joint sealed. Sealing the joint between the backsplash and the countertop is what stops water getting in behind and ruining the base cabinet, the most common failure in kitchens. Includes cutting to size, bedding in adhesive, taking up the irregularities of the wall, sealing the bottom joint with sanitary silicone and finishing the corners. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Ejecución del zócalo o rodapié escalonad: Execution of the baseboard or baseboard stepped that accompanies to the stair in its junction with the face, with the piece cortada following the profile of treads. Es the finishing that gives the finish to the stair and the work of baseboard of smaller productivity, already that each piece requires to double cutting in angle ajustado to the tread. Includes the field layout of the line sloping, the cutting of the pieces following the profile, the installation with adhesive and leveling, the grouting and the sealing of the joint with the tread. The piece is selected by the client and is priced separately. Measured in length real of the line sloping of the baseboard.

cadenas.Elaboración y mantenimiento del plan de: Preparation and maintenance of the site health and safety plan and its associated documentation, with the identification of hazards, the preventive measures and the record of actions taken. Includes writing a plan tailored to the specific site and not a generic template, identifying hazards by phase and by task, defining the collective and personal protective measures, listing the emergency telephone numbers and nearest medical center, keeping an incident log and updating the plan whenever site conditions change. Measured per plan prepared and maintained.

cadenas.Eliminación de las capas de pintura exis: Removal of the layers of existing paint in interior face or exterior, by scraping mechanical with trowel and sanding, with application spot of paint stripper chemical in gel in the paint areas very bonded or of thickness elevado. Is used when the existing paint is cuarteada, sopla or es incompatible with the new finish. Includes the protection of floors, carpentry and furniture, the ventilation of the ambient during the application of the paint stripper, the neutralization and washed of the debris chemicals, the vacuuming of the dust and the removal of the waste. Does not include the debris container, that is priced in the section of waste management. Measured in surface actually treated.
cadenas.Eliminación de pintura en paramento medi: Removal of paint from a surface by scraping and stripping.
cadenas.Eliminación de restos de adhesivo en par: Removal of adhesive residue from a surface.
cadenas.Eliminación de restos de adhesivo y pint: Removal of adhesive debris and paint vieja in face, with paint stripper or scraping, prior to the new finish. Includes the cleaning of the surface. Measured per square meter cleaned.

cadenas.Encamisado de columna de concreto armado: Jacketing of a reinforced concrete column.
Reinforced concrete jacketing of a column. Includes reinforcement and pouring. Measured per square meter jacketed.
cadenas.Enchapado cerámico en fachada o parament: Ceramic tiling on a facade or exterior surface.
cadenas.Enchapado cerámico o de porcelanato en l: Tiling ceramic or of porcelain tile in the shower area, installed on the prior waterproofing with adhesive high-performance and grouting with mortar suitable for immersion frecuente. The failure point is not the piece but the junctions: the sealing elastic of the corner wall-wall and wall-floor must be flexible and no of rigid mortar, because there es where the movement abre the joint and enters the water. Includes the checking of the waterproofing, the course field layout starting from of the point more visible, the double gluing, the cuttings around of faucets and soap dish, the grouting and the sealing elastic of all the corners. The piece is selected by the client and is priced separately. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².

Marble cladding on a base or reveal.

Tiling of a shower niche or shelf.

Face tiling with piece ceramic and joint coloreada decorative, in fine layer. Includes the installation and the grouting with joint mortar colored. Measured per square meter tiling.

Face tiling with stone piece natural installed with wide joint of mortar. Includes the substrate preparation, the installation and the wide grouting. Measured per square meter tiling.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con placas de már: Face tiling with boards of marble polishing, in fine layer. Includes the substrate preparation, the installation of the boards and the grouting. Measured per square meter tiling.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento interior con piez: Interior wall tiling with ceramic or porcelain tile, thin-set.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento interior en baños: Face tiling interior in bathrooms, kitchens and areas damp with piece ceramic or of porcelain tile rectified, on substrate previously rendering and leveled. Execution in fine layer with adhesive cement-based improved C2 TE of slippage reduced applied with trowel dentada, leveling by crucetas and shims, and grouting with mortar CG2. Includes course field layout to prevent pieces cortadas in areas exposed, cuttings and taladros for the passage of installations and mechanisms, resolution of junctions and corners, and cleaning final. The piece is selected by the client and is priced separately. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
Wall tiling with a minimal joint.

cadenas.Enchapado de piedra con junta ancha de m: Stone cladding with a wide mortar joint.
Stone cladding with a dry joint.

cadenas.Enchapado de piedra natural con anclaje: Natural stone cladding with mechanical anchors.
Swimming pool tiling with ceramic tile.

cadenas.Enchapado de vaso de piscina con pieza c: Tank tiling of swimming pool with piece ceramic or mosaic, on waterproofing. Includes the preparation, the installation and the grouting with mortar suitable for immersion. Measured per square meter tiling.
cadenas.Enchapado de zona de ducha sobre imperme: Tiling of a shower area over the waterproofing.
cadenas.Enchapado del frente de bañera con pieza: Tiling of the face of bathtub with piece ceramic or porcelain tile, leaving access inspection chamber. Includes the substrate preparation, the installation and the grouting. Measured per square meter tiling.
cadenas.Enchapado del salpicadero de cocina entr: Tiling of the kitchen splashback between countertop and high cabinets, with piece ceramic or porcelain tile. Includes the preparation, the installation and the grouting of the strip. Measured per square meter tiling.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de muro de concret: Double faced formwork to a concrete wall in lumber. Includes erection and stripping. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de muro de contenc: Double faced formwork to a retaining wall using wood panels with through ties, shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out, erecting and plumbing the first face, placing the ties and spacers that fix the thickness, closing the second face after the cage has been checked, bracing against the thrust of the wet concrete, which on a tall wall is considerable, applying release agent, stripping and making good the tie holes. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete, counting both faces.
Double-face formwork to a retaining wall.
Double faced formwork to a retaining wall. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de pantalla estruc: Double-face formwork to a structural wall.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de pantalla o muro: Double faced formwork to a structural wall using lumber panels with through ties, shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out, erecting and plumbing the first face, placing the ties and thickness spacers, closing the second face after the cage has been checked, bracing against the thrust of the wet concrete, applying release agent, stripping and making good the tie holes. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete, counting both faces.
Edge formwork to a concrete slab. Includes erecting the side formwork. Measured per meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado de columna mediante paneles de: Formwork to a column using lumber panels with clamps, shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out from the level, erecting the panels around the cage, plumbing in both directions and bracing, checking the section size and the cover, applying release agent, providing a clean-out opening at the base, stripping once the strength has been reached and cleaning and stacking the panels for reuse. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de escalera de concreto armado: Formwork to a reinforced concrete stair, comprising the soffit of the inclined slab on shores, the closing sides and the riser boards that form the steps, and its subsequent stripping. It is one of the most laborious formwork items because of the inclined geometry and the setting out of the going and the rise, which must be exact and constant because any difference between steps is felt when walking and compromises safety. Includes setting out, erecting and leveling the soffit, the sides, the riser boards, the bracing, the release agent, stripping and cleaning the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
Formwork to a reinforced concrete stair.
cadenas.Encofrado de las caras laterales de viga: Formwork to the sides of a tie beam using wood panels with shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out and erecting the panels, checking the alignment, plumb and section before the pour, the bracing that stops it opening under the thrust of the concrete, applying release agent, stripping once the necessary strength has been reached and cleaning and stacking the panels for reuse. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de las caras laterales de zapa: Formwork to the sides of a footing using wood panels with shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out and erecting the panels, checking the squareness, plumb and dimensions before the pour, the shoring and bracing that stops the formwork opening under the thrust of the wet concrete, applying release agent, careful stripping once the necessary strength has been reached, and cleaning and stacking the panels for reuse. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de losa con sistema modular de: Formwork to a slab with a modular system of shores and steel decking. Includes erecting the system. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork to a slab with a modular system.
cadenas.Encofrado de losa maciza mediante tabler: Formwork to a solid slab using lumber decking on sole plates and steel shores, leveled and with camber, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out the soffit level, erecting the grid of shores at the spacing indicated, placing the sole plates and the decking, leveling the assembly with the camber specified, sealing the joints of the decking to prevent loss of grout, applying release agent, staged stripping keeping the safety shores in place until the specified strength is reached, and cleaning and stacking the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de losa maciza sobre puntales: Formwork to a solid slab on shores in lumber. Includes erecting the shores and the decking. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork to a solid slab on shores.
cadenas.Encofrado de muro de contención a dos ca: Double-face formwork to a retaining wall.
cadenas.Encofrado de viga mediante fondo y later: Formwork to a beam with a lumber soffit and sides on shores, with its bracing, and its subsequent stripping. It is the most laborious formwork in the structure because of the shoring and the leveling of the soffit. Includes setting out the soffit level, erecting and leveling the soffit on shores with the camber specified, erecting and plumbing the sides, checking the section and alignment, applying release agent, staged stripping taking down the sides first and keeping the soffit and the shores in place until the specified strength is reached, and cleaning and stacking the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado del borde perimetral de losa d: Formwork to the perimeter edge of a mat foundation using wood boards with stakes and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out the perimeter, erecting the boards to the exact level of the top of the slab, fixing and bracing them against the thrust of the concrete, applying release agent, stripping and cleaning and stacking the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado metálico modular de columna. I: Modular steel formwork to a column. Includes erection, stripping and cleaning. Measured per square meter formed.

cadenas.Ensayo esclerométrico en elementos de co: Rebound hammer testing of concrete elements to estimate strength, with a report.
cadenas.Ensayo granulométrico de agregados (aren: Sieve analysis of aggregates (sand, gravel) to verify their suitability in the concrete mix.
cadenas.Ensayo no destructivo de la resistencia: Non-destructive testing of the strength of hardened concrete with a rebound hammer, with a report.

cadenas.Entibado de las paredes de zanja mediant: Trench sheeting to the sides of the excavation with lumber planks and struts, to support the ground and allow safe work inside. It is mandatory from the depth at which the ground stops being self-supporting, and its absence is the main cause of serious accidents in trenches. Includes installing the sheeting as the excavation advances and never afterwards, placing the planks and struts with the wedging required, daily inspection of the assembly and after every rainfall, and staged removal as the backfill proceeds. Measured by the area of trench face actually sheeted.
cadenas.Entibado de zanja con tablones y puntale: Trench sheeting with planks and struts, to prevent collapse during excavation.

cadenas.Escalera exterior de concreto armado con: External reinforced concrete stair with a non-slip finish, on ground or on a structure, with its strip footing. Includes setting out and checking that the going and the rise stay constant over the whole flight, the footing, the reinforcement, the soffit and riser formwork, pouring from the bottom up with a dry mix, floating the treads to a non-slip finish, the fall outwards on each tread so that they do not hold water, curing and striking. Measured by the developed area of treads and risers.
