cadenas.Excavación de zanja para tubería de agua: Excavation of a trench for a water pipe. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja para tubería de dren: Excavation of a trench for a drainage pipe. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
Excavation of a trench for a gas pipe. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
Excavation in hard material or rock.
cadenas.Excavación en terreno con presencia de a: Excavation in water-bearing ground, including dewatering. Includes excavation and dewatering. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación en terreno de alta compacidad: Excavation in ground of high compaction, cemented material or rock, with a hydraulic breaker mounted on a backhoe, with a hand-held pneumatic breaker for the corners. It applies where the output of conventional excavation falls below what is acceptable, a circumstance that must be recorded on site to justify the change of item. Includes breaking up the material, extracting and stockpiling it, trimming the sides and bottom, and controlling vibration where there are adjoining buildings. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación localizada a mano en interior: Localized hand excavation indoors. Includes excavation and removal. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación manual en el interior de una: Hand excavation inside an existing building, for reducing levels, constructing strengthening foundations or running buried services. Output is far lower than for open-cut excavation because of the lack of room to manoeuvre, the impossibility of using plant and the need to carry the material out by hand through the building. Includes setting out, protecting the circulation areas, excavating in layers with pick and shovel, bagging the material and carrying it to the external stockpile. Disposal is not included.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja de sección re: Hand excavation of a narrow trench for laying water pipes, drains or buried electrical conduits, to the fall required by the service. It is done by hand precisely because in built-up areas the risk of striking an existing service makes the machine inadvisable. Includes setting out the line, excavating in layers under continuous watch, stockpiling the material alongside the trench, trimming the bottom to the required fall and keeping the trench signed while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja o pozo para f: Hand excavation of a trench or pit for foundations, in ground of medium consistency, to the level and to the design dimensions. It is the usual solution on refurbishment work and extensions where plant cannot get in or the volume does not justify it. Includes setting out the trench, excavating in layers with pick and shovel, stockpiling the material far enough back from the edge not to overload it, trimming the sides and bottom, and getting the material out to the loading point. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja para fundacio: Hand excavation of a foundation trench.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja para instalac: Hand excavation of a trench for buried services.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada a cielo abierto co: Mechanical open-cut excavation with the material cast to one side. Includes excavation and stockpiling of the material removed. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada a cielo abierto en: Mechanical open-cut excavation in soft ground. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
Mechanical open-cut excavation in hard ground. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada a cielo abierto pa: Mechanical open-cut excavation for general bulk excavation, reducing levels or forming a platform, with a backhoe or skid steer loader, in ground of medium consistency. Includes setting out and marking the final level, excavating in layers, stockpiling the material on site or loading it directly onto a truck, hand trimming of the edges and slopes, and survey control of the level achieved. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design levels.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada en zanja o pozo pa: Mechanical excavation of a trench or pit for foundations with a backhoe, in ground of medium consistency, to the level and to the design dimensions. Includes setting out, excavation by machine, stockpiling the material far enough back from the edge, hand trimming of the sides and bottom that the machine cannot achieve, and watching during excavation so that work stops if unforeseen buried services are found. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada en zanja para fund: Mechanical excavation of a foundation trench.
cadenas.Excavación para cimientos de edificación: Excavation for the foundations of a building.
Excavation for the footings of a building. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación para el alojamiento de tanque: Excavation to receive a septic tank, catch basin, buried water tank or similar, to the design dimensions plus the working space needed for installation and subsequent backfilling around it. Includes setting out, excavation by mechanical means with hand trimming, trimming the bottom to the exact bearing level, checking the stability of the sides and sheeting them where the depth requires it, and signing and covering the void while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación para piscina o tanque enterra: Excavation for a swimming pool or buried tank. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
Excavation for a swimming pool or tank.
cadenas.Excavación para tanque séptico, sumidero: Excavation for a septic tank, catch basin or buried tank.
CO2 fire extinguisher for an electrical panel.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de alacena o a: Manufacture and installation of a melamine storage cupboard, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de alacena o d: Manufacture and installation of a full height kitchen pantry, with its shelves, drawers or pull-out system. Includes measuring on site, preparing the cutting list and cutting with edge banding, assembling and anchoring the carcass to the wall and to the floor, leveling, fitting the shelves and the pull-out systems with their runners, fitting the doors and adjusting them and the trim at the top against the ceiling. Measured by the length of pantry front.
Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen pantry, with shelves and doors. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de asiento o b: Manufacture and installation of fixed seating or a bench in melamine or wood, fixed. Includes cutting list and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de barra de ba: Manufacture and installation of a bar or cafeteria counter in melamine or wood, with a countertop. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de closet de v: Manufacture and installation of a melamine walk-in closet with drawer units, hanging rails and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de closet empo: Manufacture and installation of a built-in closet to measure in melamine, with doors, shelves and a hanging rail. Includes cutting list and assembly.

Manufacture and installation of a built-in closet to measure in melamine board, with its carcass, shelves, hanging rails and drawers, to the cutting list agreed. Includes measuring on site and checking the opening for plumb and square, preparing the cutting list and cutting the boards with edge banding, erecting the carcass level and plumb on shims, taking up the irregularities of the wall with a scribe, fitting the shelves, rails and drawers with their slides and the final adjustment. Measured by the area of closet front.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de gabinete al: Manufacture and installation of a moisture resistant melamine bathroom wall cabinet, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de isla o pení: Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen island or peninsula, with countertop and drawers. Includes assembly, leveling and fixing.

Manufacture and installation of a kitchen island or peninsula, with its carcass, cabinets to one or both faces, and provision for services. Includes prior coordination of the water, waste and electrical points that have to fall within the island and are installed before the floor, a point which if overlooked means breaking out the finished floor, anchoring the carcass to the floor so that it cannot move, assembling and leveling the units, fitting the doors and drawers and the end panels. The countertop is not included. Measured by the length of island.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mostrador d: Manufacture and installation of a reception counter in melamine or wood, with a countertop. Includes cutting list and assembly.
Manufacture and installation of a commercial display counter, in melamine with glass. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble alto: Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen wall cabinet, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list, assembly and fixing to the wall.

Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen wall cabinet, with its carcass, doors and shelves, hung from the wall. Includes checking that the wall can carry the load, since a loaded wall cabinet is heavy and on a plasterboard partition needs internal strengthening beforehand, setting out the working height in coordination with the countertop and backsplash, fitting the hanging rail or brackets, assembling and hanging the units, leveling and joining them, fitting the doors on adjustable hinges and adjusting the fronts. Measured by the length of cabinet front.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble bajo: Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen base cabinet with an opening for the sink. Includes cutting list, assembly and the cut-out for the sink.
Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen base cabinet, with doors, drawers and plinth. Includes measuring, cutting list, assembly, leveling and adjustment of the fronts.

Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen base cabinet, with its carcass, doors, drawers, shelves and plinth. Includes measuring on site and checking plumb and square, preparing the cutting list and cutting with edge banding, allowing for the openings and cut-outs for pipework and electrical outlets before assembly, assembling the units, leveling on adjustable legs, joining the units together, fitting the doors and drawers with their slides and adjusting the fronts until the reveals are even. Measured by the length of cabinet front.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de b: Manufacture and installation of a moisture resistant melamine bathroom vanity unit with an opening for the basin. Includes cutting list, assembly and fixing.
Manufacture and installation of a wall hung bathroom vanity unit, fixed to the wall on brackets. Includes assembly and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de d: Manufacture and installation of a melamine pantry unit with drawers and adjustable shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
Manufacture and installation of a melamine bedroom unit to measure (chest of drawers), with drawers and pulls. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de e: Manufacture and installation of a melamine corner kitchen cabinet, with access to the back of the corner. Includes cutting list and assembly.
Manufacture and installation of external furniture to measure in treated lumber. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de l: Manufacture and installation of a moisture resistant melamine laundry unit with an opening for the sink. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de r: Manufacture and installation of a melamine reception unit, with a countertop and fronts. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de v: Manufacture and installation of a glazed display cabinet with doors. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de á: Manufacture and installation of a melamine unit for a common area, with seating or a work surface. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble fijo: Manufacture and installation of a fixed cabinet to measure in melamine or wood, to the cutting list agreed with the client, for entrance halls, living rooms, desks or other uses. Includes measuring on site, preparing the cutting list and cutting with edge banding, assembling the carcass, anchoring and leveling it to the wall and to the floor, fitting the doors, drawers and shelves with their hardware, adjusting the fronts and finishing with a scribe that takes up the irregularities of the wall. Measured by the area of cabinet front.
Manufacture and installation of a fixed cabinet to measure in melamine, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portillo pe: Manufacture and installation of a metal pedestrian gate in the boundary, with a frame and a lock. Includes assembly and the lock.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón corr: Manufacture and installation of a sliding access gate, with a track and carriers. Includes assembly and painting. The gate is selected by the client.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón de a: Manufacture and installation of a metal vehicular access gate, with a frame, hinges and paint. Includes assembly and painting. The gate is selected by the client.

Manufacture and installation of a vehicular access gate, hinged or sliding, with its frame, facing, hardware and anchors. Includes fabricating the reinforced frame sized for the opening, the anti-corrosion treatment, constructing or checking the piers or the track according to the type of opening, assembly and leveling, adjusting the travel and the stops, fitting the lock or latch and providing the electrical conduit if it is to be motorized. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón de m: Manufacture and installation of a wire mesh access gate, with a frame and hinges. Includes assembly. The gate is selected by the client.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón peat: Manufacture and installation of a metal pedestrian gate, with a frame and a lock. Includes assembly and painting. The gate is selected by the client.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de repisa o es: Manufacture and installation of a fixed shelf or shelving unit in melamine or wood, with its supports anchored to the wall. Includes setting out the height and the spacing of the supports according to the thickness of the board and the load expected, since a shelf with supports too far apart sags permanently, anchoring the supports with the system suited to the type of wall, cutting and edging the board, placing and leveling it and finishing the exposed edges. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de verja metál: Manufacture and installation of a metal railing for the boundary, with bars and a frame, painted. Includes assembly and painting.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de zapatero em: Manufacture and installation of a built-in melamine shoe cabinet, with sloping shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación o suministro e instalación d: Manufacture or supply and installation of a bathroom vanity unit with an integrated or overmount basin, wall hung or floor standing. Includes checking the strengthening of the wall for wall hung units, which carry the weight of the unit plus that of the basin when full, setting out the working height, allowing for the cut-outs for the waste and the supplies, anchoring, leveling, fitting the doors and drawers with adjustment and sealing the perimeter against the wall. The unit and the basin are selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de puerta abati: Manufacture and installation of a hinged closet door, with hinges and a pull. Includes assembly and adjustment.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de puerta corre: Manufacture and installation of a sliding closet door, with top and bottom tracks and carriers. Includes assembly and adjustment.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de puerta de cl: Manufacture and installation of a closet door with an integrated mirror, hinged or sliding. Includes assembly and adjustment.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de repisa o est: Manufacture and installation of a fixed shelf or shelving unit, in melamine or wood, fixed to the wall. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de tapa de mesó: Manufacture and installation of a wood or melamine countertop, with edge banding. Includes cutting list and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de baranda metálic: Manufacture and installation of a metal guardrail to a balcony, terrace or stair, with its handrail, posts and bars, anchored to the floor or to the edge of the slab. The height and the spacing of the bars are not free design choices: they answer to safety criteria against falling and against a child passing between them. Includes fabrication, the anti-corrosion treatment, setting out and mechanically anchoring the posts, making good the anchors, checking the stiffness of the assembly against horizontal thrust and the finish. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de entrepaños, caj: Manufacture and fitting of melamine closet shelves, drawer units, shoe storage and internal organisers, with their supports and hardware. Includes preparing the cutting list to the layout agreed, cutting and edging, setting out the working heights, fitting the supports and shelves level, fitting the drawers on their slides and adjusting the fronts. Measured by the length of shelf or organiser actually installed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de estructura metá: Manufacture and installation of minor metalwork, such as canopies, pergolas, equipment supports and ancillary structures, with its anti-corrosion treatment. Includes setting out, cutting and assembling the sections, welding the joints and cleaning off the slag, the anti-corrosion treatment, hoisting and erection, anchoring to the support and the geometric check. Measured by the weight actually erected.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de portón de reja: Manufacture and installation of a hinged grille gate for pedestrian or vehicular access, with its frame, reinforced hinges, latch and lock. Includes fabricating the frame and the surround, the anti-corrosion treatment, fixing the surround anchored to the piers, hanging it on hinges sized for the weight, adjusting the level so that the gate neither swings open nor shuts by itself, fitting the latch and the lock and the finish. Measured by the area actually carried out.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de pérgola de made: Manufacture and assembly of an external pergola in treated lumber, with its posts, beams, purlins and anchors to the base. In a tropical climate the point of failure is always where the post meets the floor: lumber in direct contact with concrete takes up moisture by capillary action and rots from the bottom up, so it must stand on a metal shoe that holds it clear of the floor. Includes forming the anchorage blocks, fitting the post shoes, cutting and shaping the members, erecting the structure with temporary supports, fixing with the hardware and applying preservative to every face and every end grain. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de reja de protecc: Manufacture and installation of a metal security grille with its frame and bars, anchored to the wall. Includes setting out and measuring on site, fabricating the frame with its bars at the spacing agreed, the anti-corrosion treatment, offering up and mechanical anchoring to the wall with cast-in bolts or resin, making good the anchor points and applying the primer and the finish. cadenas.Formación de cumbrera y limatesa en cubi: Formation of the ridge and hips on a tiled roof with purpose-made units bedded in mortar, to close the slope weathertight. Includes bedding and sealing.

cadenas.Formación de jambas y mochetas de vano c: Formation of the jambs and reveals of an opening in mortar.

cadenas.Formación de media caña de mortero en el: Formation of average cane of mortar in the wall junction with floor, to remove the arris interior in kitchens, areas of service and hygiene premises demanding. The arris live es where accumulates the dirt and by where the cleaning water penetra low the coating; the average cane the removes and allows the continuous sweeping. Includes the cleaning and dampened, the laying of the mortar with water-repellent, the shaping with template and the floating leaving the surface ready to receive the coating or the sealing. Measured in length actually completed.
cadenas.Formación de pendientes con concreto lig: Formation of falls in low strength lightweight concrete on a flat roof, to create the drop towards the roof drains or channels. Includes the perimeter formwork, spreading and screeding to rails and curing the surface.
cadenas.Formación de pendientes en cubierta plan: Formation of falls on a flat roof with a lightweight mortar fill, to the varying thickness needed to direct water to the roof drains at the minimum gradient specified. It is the layer that decides whether the roof drains or ponds, and the commonest mistake is to leave too little fall or to create back falls next to the parapets. Includes setting out the hip lines and the low points at the drains, placing screed rails, spreading and screeding the mortar, floating and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Formación de pendientes sobre base de cu: Screed to falls over the roof deck in cement mortar lightweightened with expanded clay or polystyrene, to direct water to the drainage points. Includes setting out screed rails, laying the fill to increasing thicknesses and the final floating of the surface.
cadenas.Formación del alero y del remate del bor: Formation of the eaves and the edge trim of the roof, with the closing unit, drip edge and sealant. The drip edge is what breaks the water away from the wall: without it the water runs round the edge by capillary action and down the facade, leaving the characteristic staining below badly detailed eaves. Includes setting out, placing the trim with its projection, forming the drip, sealing the junction with the roof and with the wall and fixing. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Formación del brocal o antepecho de vent: Formation of the frame or window parapet in wall of masonry, with its upper finishing conformado with the slope towards the exterior that discharges the rainwater water. Esa slope and the drip edge lower are what prevents that the water run off by the facade and termine low filtering the window, defects very frecuente when the frame is carried out flat. Includes the field layout of the level, the execution of the masonry of the parapet, the shaping of the slope and of the drip edge, and the solid of the sides supports. Does not include the sill of finish. Measured in length actually completed.

cadenas.Impermeabilización con membrana líquida: Waterproofing with a high elasticity liquid polyurethane membrane, applied in two coats over a primer, forming a continuous seamless layer. Against acrylic it offers greater elasticity, better resistance to permanent ponding and a longer service life, at a higher cost. Includes preparing and repairing the substrate, priming, reinforcing the junctions and penetrations with a strip, applying the coats crosswise respecting the consumption and the time between coats, and protecting it from traffic until fully cured. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Waterproofing with a liquid polyurethane membrane.
cadenas.Impermeabilización con mortero cementoso: Waterproofing with a two-component flexible cementitious mortar applied in two cross coats by brush or trowel. Unlike bituminous and polyurethane systems, it can stay in permanent contact with water and receive tiling directly on top, which is why it is the system for tanks, planters and wet areas beneath ceramic tile. Includes pre-saturating the substrate, reinforcing the junctions and corners with an elastic strip, applying the two cross coats and the watertightness test. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Impermeabilización de balcón con acrílic: Waterproofing of a balcony with elastomeric acrylic and mesh. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the acrylic. Measured per square meter waterproofed.

cadenas.Impermeabilización de balcón con manta a: Waterproofing of a balcony with a bituminous membrane or a liquid membrane. Includes preparing the substrate and application. Measured per square meter waterproofed.

cadenas.Impermeabilización de balcón o terraza t: Waterproofing of a trafficable balcony or terrace with a flexible cementitious membrane beneath the floor finish, with the junctions reinforced and the edge treated. The critical point is the junction with the wall and the finish at the outer edge: the membrane must turn up the wall above the level of the finished floor and terminate at the drip of the edge, not be cut off flush. Includes checking the falls, reinforcing the junctions and drains, the coats of membrane with the perimeter upstand, the watertightness test and protection until the floor is laid. Measured by the area actually constructed, deducting voids over 1 m².

cadenas.Impermeabilización de muro enterrado por: Waterproofing of a buried wall on its internal face with a negative side cementitious mortar, where it is not possible to excavate to treat it from the external face. It works against the pressure of water pushing from outside, a far more demanding situation than conventional waterproofing, so it requires a specific product and a perfectly sound and rough substrate. Includes hacking off the existing rendering back to the substrate, cutting out and opening the pore, plugging active water paths with rapid setting cement, reinforcing the junctions and the coats of negative side mortar. Measured by the area actually constructed, deducting voids over 1 m².

cadenas.Impermeabilización del piso de baño, duc: Waterproofing of the floor of a bathroom, shower or utility room with a flexible cementitious membrane, with the junctions reinforced and the drain treated, as a base beneath the tiling. It is the layer that holds the water that passes through the ceramic tile and the grout, which are not watertight. The critical point is the junction of the floor with the wall and the collar of the drain: that is where 90 % of the bathrooms that leak to the floor below fail. Includes saturating the substrate, reinforcing every junction with a strip, treating the drain with its collar, the two cross coats and the ponding test before tiling. Measured by the area actually constructed.

Includes preparing the inside, reinforcing the junctions and corners, the coats of membrane, treating the drain penetration, laying the geotextile and the gravel drainage layer before the growing medium. Measured by the area actually constructed.

The product must be certified for potable water: an ordinary waterproofing compound releases compounds into the water and makes it unfit to drink. Includes emptying and cleaning the tank, cutting out and patching the walls, reinforcing every junction and pipe penetration with a strip, the coats of cementitious mortar, curing, the watertightness test by filling and washing and disinfecting before it is brought into service. Measured by the area actually constructed, deducting voids over 1 m².

cadenas.Refuerzo con banda de manto asfáltico en: Reinforcement with a strip of bituminous membrane at the junctions of the roof with parapets, chimneys, walls and other vertical elements, with an angle fillet formed at the arris and an upstand of at least 20 cm above the plane of the roof. The vertical junctions are where waterproofing almost always fails, not the center of the field. Includes forming the angle fillet in mortar, priming, laying the reinforcement strip, the upstand and its mechanical fixing at the top with a bead and sealant. Measured by the length of junction actually reinforced.
cadenas.Refuerzo con mortero de alta resistencia: Strengthening with a high strength mortar. Includes application. Measured per square meter strengthened.
cadenas.Refuerzo de aislamiento en petos y canto: Additional insulation at parapets and slab edges.
cadenas.Refuerzo de celda vertical con acero y r: Reinforcement of a vertical cell with steel and concrete fill.

cadenas.Refuerzo de columna con lámina de fibra: Strengthening of a column with a carbon fiber plate. Includes application. Measured per square meter strengthened.
cadenas.Refuerzo de columna existente mediante e: Strengthening of an existing column by reinforced concrete jacketing, increasing its section with a perimeter layer of concrete with its own reinforcement, tied to the original core. Includes shoring the structure beforehand to take the load off the column, hacking the existing surface to provide a bond, drilling and chemically anchoring the dowels that stitch the jacket to the core, the longitudinal reinforcement and the confinement stirrups, the formwork, pouring with shrinkage-compensating concrete or a fluid mortar given the small thickness, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the length of column actually jacketed.
cadenas.Refuerzo de elemento estructural de conc: Strengthening of a structural concrete element by bonding carbon fiber fabric with a saturating epoxy resin. It adds flexural or shear capacity with almost no added weight and no change to the geometry, which makes it ideal in refurbishment where the section cannot be increased. Includes preparing and sanding the substrate to a flat surface free of laitance, rounding the arrises over which the fabric has to bend, priming, applying the saturating resin, laying the fabric in the direction of the tension and rolling out the air bubbles, the second coat of resin and curing. Measured by the area of fabric actually applied.
cadenas.Refuerzo de encuentros y petos en imperm: Reinforcement of junctions and parapets in a bituminous waterproofing.
cadenas.Refuerzo de estructura con perfil metáli: Strengthening of a structure with steel sections. Includes installing the strengthening. Measured per square meter strengthened.

cadenas.Refuerzo de estructura de techo con angu: Strengthening a roof structure with bolted steel angles, to stiffen joints or correct deformation. Includes fixing.

cadenas.Refuerzo de losa con lámina de fibra de: Strengthening of a slab with a carbon fiber plate. Includes application. Measured per square meter strengthened.

cadenas.Refuerzo de losa o viga con perfil metál: Strengthening of a slab or beam with a steel section.

cadenas.Refuerzo de losa o viga de concreto medi: Strengthening of a concrete slab or beam with a steel section placed beneath the element, connected with chemical anchors and with a leveling mortar at the interface. It is the quickest solution when the capacity of an existing slab has to be increased without thickening it from above. Includes shoring the element to be strengthened beforehand, leveling the soffit, drilling and chemical anchoring, hoisting and offering up the section, filling the interface with non-shrink grout to guarantee the transfer of load, since a section that does not bear does not strengthen, tightening the anchors and anti-corrosion protection. Measured by the length of strengthening actually constructed.
cadenas.Refuerzo de muro con encamisado de concr: Strengthening of a wall with concrete jacketing. Includes reinforcement and pouring. Measured per square meter strengthened.
Strengthening of a wall by jacketing.
cadenas.Refuerzo de muro de contención existente: Strengthening of an existing retaining wall.
Strengthening of an existing retaining wall. Includes the strengthening and the cover. Measured per square meter strengthened.
cadenas.Refuerzo de vano con perfil de acero en: Opening reinforcement with steel profile in corners. Includes the fabrication and the installation of the reinforcement. Measured per linear meter completed.

cadenas.Refuerzo de viga con lámina de fibra de: Strengthening of a beam with a carbon fiber plate. Includes application. Measured per square meter strengthened.

cadenas.Refuerzo de zapata existente mediante am: Strengthening of an existing footing by widening its area with a ring of reinforced concrete tied to the original element. Includes exposing the existing footing, hacking its surface to provide a bond, drilling and chemically anchoring the dowels that stitch the widening to the core, reinforcing the ring, the formwork, pouring with shrinkage-compensating concrete, curing and the perimeter backfill. Measured by the area of widening actually constructed.
cadenas.Refuerzo estructural con tejido de fibra: Structural strengthening with carbon fiber fabric.

cadenas.Regularización de paramento existente me: Leveling of existing face by mortar stucco of thickness variable, to correct desplomes, resanar areas chippings and leave the surface suitable to receive the finish. Is used in renovation when the existing stucco is sound in its larger parte and only requires repair and leveling, avoiding the chipping complete. Includes the borehole by hammering to delimit and remove the areas openings, the cleaning and dampened, the application of the adhesion bridge in the areas of larger thickness, the laying and screeding of the mortar flushing with the existing stucco, and the floating leaving to transition imperceptible between it new and it conservado. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Regularización de paramento interior con: Leveling of interior face with mortar of leveling to correct unevenness prior to the finish. Includes the field layout, the application and the fine finishing. Measured per square meter leveled.

cadenas.Regularización de soporte mediante morte: Leveling of substrate by self-leveling mortar of base cement, of 5 mm of thickness mean, to leave the surface in flatness conditions suitables to receive paving ceramic, incluso of large size. Includes cleaning and prior vacuuming of the substrate, application of primer tapaporos for regular the absorption, installation of perimeter band of debonding, mixing mechanical, tipping, spreading and desaireado of the product, and waiting up to transitabilidad. Measured in area actually completed.
cadenas.Regularización de techo de concreto prev: Leveling of concrete ceiling prior to the installation of suspended ceiling or paint, with mortar or compound of leveling. Includes the correction of unevenness and the fine finishing. Measured per square meter leveled.
cadenas.Regularización de techo previo a cielo r: Leveling of the soffit before the suspended ceiling.

cadenas.Relleno compactado en capas con material: Backfill compacted in layers with material from the site. Includes spreading and compaction in layers. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno con material de excavación reuti: Backfill with reused excavated material, after screening. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno con material granular de préstam: Backfill with imported granular fill. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno con material granular selecciona: Backfill with selected imported granular fill, such as natural run of crusher, spread and compacted in layers not exceeding 20 cm, used where the material on site does not meet the requirements. Includes supply and placing of the material, spreading it in layers, moisture conditioning to optimum moisture content, compacting each layer to the specified density and checking the final level. Measured by the volume of compacted fill to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Relleno de celda vertical de mampostería: Fill of cell vertical of masonry with its reinforcing steel and concrete fluid, in the positions that indica the project. Es the operation that convierte to block wall in to structural element, and its failure typical es the fill incompleto by segregation or by obstruction of the cell with rebabas of mortar. Includes the prior cleaning of the undercoat of the cell by the window of inspection, the installation and centrado of the steel with its laps, the concrete placing of the concrete fluid by sections limited in height and its vibration or compacted with varilla. Measured in length of cell actually fill.
cadenas.Relleno de nivelación de piso con morter: Fill of leveling of floor with mortar dry compacted, to level before of the finish. Includes the field layout, the spreading and the compaction. Measured per square meter leveled.

cadenas.Relleno de zanja de instalaciones con ar: Backfill of a services trench with washed sand, forming the bedding beneath the pipe and the surround up to 20 cm above its crown, to protect it from point loads and from contact with coarse material. Includes supply and placing of the sand, forming the bed to the fall of the service, filling the sides and over the top in layers with careful hand compaction so as not to displace or damage the pipe, and laying warning tape over the surround. Measured by the volume of sand actually placed.
Backfill of a services trench with sand.
Backfill of a services trench with sand. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno de zanjas, trasdós de muros o re: Backfill to trenches, behind walls or to reduced levels with the material arising from the excavation itself, provided it is suitable through containing no organic matter or compressible elements, spread and compacted in layers not exceeding 20 cm. Includes selecting and rough screening the stockpiled material, spreading it in layers, moisture conditioning to optimum moisture content, compacting each layer with a rammer or plate compactor depending on the space, and checking the final level. Measured by the volume of compacted fill to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Relleno estructural con piedra picada co: Structural backfill with compacted crushed stone. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno y compactación con material del: Backfill and compaction with material from the site.
cadenas.Relleno y compactación con material gran: Backfill and compaction with imported granular fill.

cadenas.Reparación de concreto deteriorado por c: Repair of concrete damaged by honeycombing, spalling or carbonation, by cutting out the area and reinstating with a thixotropic structural repair mortar, 3 cm average thickness. Includes defining the area with a square perimeter cut to avoid feather edges that come away, hacking out the loose concrete back to sound concrete, cleaning and saturating the substrate, applying the bonding coat, reinstating the mortar in layers respecting the maximum thickness per layer and curing the material applied. Measured by the area actually repaired.

Repair of a leak in a terrace.

cadenas.Reparación de losa con mortero estructur: Repair of a slab with a structural mortar. Includes cutting out and repair. Measured per square meter repaired.

cadenas.Reparación de membrana de cubierta plana: Repair of the membrane of a flat roof.
cadenas.Reparación de mesón de piedra con resane: Repair of a stone countertop by filling cracks, polishing and sealing. Includes repair and finishing.

cadenas.Reparación de mueble de baño con ajuste: Repair of a bathroom cabinet with adjustment of the hardware and replacement of damaged parts. Includes inspection and adjustment.
Repair of a bathroom vanity unit.

Repair of a wall with mortar.

cadenas.Reparación de viga con mortero estructur: Repair of a beam with a structural mortar. Includes cutting out and repair. Measured per square meter repaired.
Repair of a beam with mortar.
cadenas.Reparación de zonas puntuales de friso d: Repair of areas stucco spots of gypsum deteriorated by impacts, damp already resueltas or spalling, with restoration of the material and leveling off with the existing stucco. Includes the demarcation and removal of the material loose up to encontrar stucco sound and well bonded, the cleaning and dampened of the edge, the application of the adhesion bridge, the restoration by layers of the compound, the leveling off with the existing surface and the sanding of the transition. In repairs on damp es essential haber eliminado before the cause, because of it contrario the area vuelve to fallar. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Reparación puntual de cubierta con susti: Localized repair of a roof by replacing the damaged length of membrane or sheeting, with the laps sealed. Includes cleaning and sealing.
cadenas.Reparación puntual de cubierta en zonas: Localized repair of a roof where there is a local leak, cutting out the area, replacing the waterproofing and reinforcing the point of failure. Includes cleaning and preparing around the penetration, fitting the collar or wall sleeve, reinforcing with a strip embedded in the waterproofing, sealing with a compatible elastic mastic and checking. Includes mapping beforehand and recording the width and the run of the cracks, determining whether the crack is live or dormant, since injecting a moving crack with a rigid resin makes it reappear alongside the seal, cleaning the run, fitting the ports and sealing the surface of the crack, injecting progressively from port to port until it appears at the next, setting, and removing the ports and the seal and making good the surface. Measured by the length of crack actually injected.

Includes checking the anchorage and the strengthening of the support, which must be sized for the horizontal thrust required by the regulations, fitting the profile or the clamps, placing and plumbing the glass on its setting blocks, wedging and sealing, and fitting the top handrail that protects the edge. Measured by the area actually carried out.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de barra de apo: Supply and installation of a stainless steel grab bar in an accessible bathroom, anchored to the wall. The anchorage is the critical part: a grab bar has to take the full weight of a person leaning on it or falling against it, so fixing it with plastic plugs into plasterboard without internal strengthening serves no purpose beyond the decorative. Includes checking or providing the strengthening of the backing, setting out the standard height and position, drilling, mechanical or chemical anchoring depending on the substrate and load testing. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de canal de dre: Supply and installation of a precast linear drainage channel with its grate, on a concrete bed, connected to the drainage system. Includes setting out the line and the fall to the discharge point, excavation, pouring the bed, setting the channel to the exact level, which must sit a couple of millimetres below the finished paving so that water enters it rather than riding over it, the haunching, the outlet connection and fitting the grate. cadenas.Suministro e instalación de canalón de a: Supply and installation of gutter of waters rainwater. Includes the installation. Measured per linear meter installed.

It is an element widely used in a tropical climate to ventilate utility rooms, stores and bathrooms that have no opening window. Includes measuring the opening, erecting and plumbing the frame, anchoring, sealing the perimeter, fitting the insect mesh on the inside face and checking the free ventilation area. Measured by the area actually carried out.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de cinta LED co: Supply and installation of tape LED with its aluminum profile disipador, difusor and source of supply, for lighting indirecta in cornices, low cabinets or in niches. cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mampara de d: Supply and installation of a tempered glass shower or bath screen, with its profiles, hardware and sealing. Tempered glass admits no cutting or drilling after toughening, so every dimension and every hole must be defined before it is made: an error in measuring means the whole unit has to be remade. Includes measuring on site over the finished tiling, fitting the profiles and hardware, installing the glass on its setting blocks, adjusting the door and sealing with sanitary silicone, leaving the inner bottom edge free so that water drains back inside. Measured by the area actually carried out.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mampara divi: Supply and installation of screen office dividing, solid, glazed or mixed, with its profiles, panels, joints and finishings. Includes the field layout of the line, the fastening of the guides to floor and ceiling with acoustic sealing, the installation of the studs plumbing, the installation of panels and glazing with its joints, the door adjustment yes the hubiera and the perimeter finishing. Measured in area actually completed.

cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mesón de gra: Supply and installation of a granite, quartz or natural stone countertop onto cabinets or a supporting structure, with its profiled edge and the sink and cooktop cut-outs. cadenas.Suministro e instalación de puerta de cl: Supply and installation of a hinged or folding closet door, with its hardware, guides and pulls. Supply and installation of a tempered glass kitchen divider, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.

cadenas.Suministro y colocación de soporte para: Supply and installation of a support bracket for a condensing unit. Includes anchoring the bracket. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de soportes anti: Supply and installation of anti-vibration mounts to HVAC or pumping equipment. Includes fitting the mounts and adjusting them. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de tapa de regis: Supply and installation of inspection chamber cover operable in suspended ceiling, for access to passage valves, boxes of connection, units of air conditioning or any element that requires maintenance. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de techo de vidr: Supply and installation of a tempered glass roof over an internal courtyard, with its supporting structure. Includes the structure, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.

cadenas.Suministro y colocación de trasdosado di: Supply and installation of lining direct of gypsum board of 12,5 mm bonded to the face with grip compound, without metal structure. Includes the checking of that the wall no tenga damp activa, the application of the compound in dabs, the presentation of the board to plumb, the joint treatment and the junction finishing. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana de PV: Supply and installation of a PVC window with double glazing. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a sliding PVC window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana de al: Supply and installation of a two sash sliding aluminium window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a single casement aluminium window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminium window opening as an awning, with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and adjusting the mechanism. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminium window with double glazing. Includes erecting the frame, installing the window and sealing the perimeter. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminium window with an integrated ventilation grille. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and the grille. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminium window with frosted glass for privacy. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminium window with safety laminated glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminium sliding window with an integrated insect screen. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and the screen. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana de ma: Supply and installation of a wood window with a louvered ventilation panel. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and the louvres. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a wood window with glass and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a sliding wood window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana fija: Supply and installation of a fixed aluminium window for a shop or a shopfront. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana oscil: Supply and installation of an aluminium tilt and turn window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and adjusting the mechanism. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana proye: Supply and installation of an aluminium awning window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventanal de v: Supply and installation of a fixed internal glazed screen, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio blinda: Supply and installation of security glass, sealed. Includes measuring and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio decora: Supply and installation of decorative etched or sandblasted glass, sealed. Includes measuring and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio en car: Supply and installation of glass in existing or new joinery, with its setting blocks, glazing beads and sealing. Includes measuring the rabbet with the expansion clearance needed, since glass fitted tight with no clearance cracks with thermal expansion, cleaning the rabbet, placing the setting blocks and side blocks in the correct position for the type of sash, wedging the glass, fitting the glazing beads and sealing the perimeter. Measured by the area actually carried out.
Supply and installation of glass in joinery.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio esmeri: Supply and installation of frosted glass in an internal division, for privacy. Includes measuring and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio lamina: Supply and installation of safety laminated glass in joinery. Includes measuring, cutting and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of safety laminated glass in an access door. Includes measuring, cutting and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio templa: Supply and installation of tempered glass in existing joinery. Includes measuring, cutting and installation with sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de viga de mader: Supply and installation of a structural lumber beam. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a glue laminated lumber beam. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación del botiquín de: Supply and installation of the site first aid kit, stocked and replenished during the works. Includes siting it in a visible and accessible place known to all personnel, periodic checking of the contents and expiry dates, replacement of what has been used and signage of its location together with the emergency telephone numbers. Measured per first aid kit installed and maintained.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación del conjunto de: Supply and installation of the set of safety signage for the site: warning, mandatory, prohibition and emergency signs, barrier tape and cones. Includes siting each sign at the point where the risk is real and visible before anyone is exposed to it, fixing the signs, delimiting the risk areas and maintaining and replacing them during the works. Measured per set of signage installed.
cadenas.Suministro y dotación de botiquín de pri: Supply and stocking of a site first aid kit, with its replenishment.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de bajante de aguas: Supply and installation of a PVC rainwater downpipe, with its brackets, bends and connection to the drainage system. Includes setting out the run, fixing the brackets to the wall at the spacing specified, assembling the lengths with the offset and shoe bends, sealing the joints and connecting to the inspection chamber or discharge point, avoiding a free discharge onto the ground, which erodes it and splashes the facade. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de baranda o pasama: Supply and installation of a stainless steel guardrail or handrail with its posts, tubes and joint fittings, anchored to the floor or to the edge of the slab. Includes setting out, cutting and polishing the tubes, erecting the posts with their bases mechanically anchored, assembling the runs with fittings or by stainless welding, polishing the joints until they match the finish of the tube and checking the stiffness against horizontal thrust. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de canal de recogid: Supply and installation of a rainwater gutter at the eaves, with its brackets, unions, stop ends and connection to the downpipe. The fall towards the downpipe is what decides whether the gutter drains or overflows: a gutter set level fills with water and leaves and ends up discharging over the facade. Includes setting out to the minimum fall to the outlet, fixing the brackets at the spacing specified, assembling the gutter, sealing the unions, fitting the stop ends and connecting to the downpipe. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de cercha de madera: Supply and erection of a lumber truss. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de columna metálica: Supply and erection of a steel column. Includes hoisting, erection and fixing. Measured per meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de correas metálica: Supply and erection of cold formed steel purlins to support the roof covering, fixed to the main structure by bolting or welding, with their sag rods and spacers. Includes taking delivery of and checking the material, setting out the purlin spacing according to the permissible span of the roof covering, hoisting and offering up, fixing to the main structure, placing the sag rods that prevent lateral buckling and checking the alignment and the plane of support for the roof covering. Measured by the weight actually erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de correas o viguet: Supply and installation of lumber purlins or joists to support a roof covering or intermediate floor, fixed to the main structure with connectors or nailing. Includes taking delivery of and selecting the pieces, setting out the spacing between centers, cutting to length, offering up and leveling, fixing to the bearings, placing the bracing or blocking that prevents lateral overturning and checking the plane of support. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de escalera metálic: Supply and erection of a steel stair with a guardrail. Includes erecting the stair and the guardrail. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of a steel stair with grating treads. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of a steel spiral stair. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of a steel escape stair. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.

Supply and erection of a structural steel stair of rolled section stringers, treads and landings, with its anchors to the structure. Includes checking the actual levels at the foot and the head on site before fabrication, an essential step because a steel stair admits no adjustment in place, hoisting and offering up the stringers, leveling and plumbing them, making the welded or bolted connections, fitting the treads and landings and checking that the going and the rise stay constant over the whole flight. It does not include the guardrails or the finish to the treads. Measured by the weight actually erected.
Supply and erection of a structural steel stair. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de estructura de ma: Supply and erection of a sawn lumber structure of beams, rafters and ties, with joints made using metal connectors or traditional carpentry joints. Includes taking delivery of and checking the section sizes, the moisture content and the absence of defects that would compromise capacity, cutting and shaping the members, offering up and fitting the joints, hoisting and erecting with temporary supports, final fixing, the geometric check of the assembly and adjusting the camber. It does not include the preservative treatment or the connectors, which are priced separately. Measured by the volume of lumber actually placed.

Supply and erection of a lumber roof structure of rafters, purlins and ties, with metal connector joints, and its preservative treatment. Includes selecting the members and checking the section sizes and the absence of defects, cutting and shaping, hoisting and erecting with temporary supports, fixing with the hardware, applying preservative to every face and particularly to the end grain and the bearing areas, and checking levels and falls. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Supply and erection of a wood structure.
Supply and erection of a lumber structure. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per cubic meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de estructura metál: Supply and erection of structural steelwork with full anti-corrosion protection. Includes erection and protection. Measured per square meter erected.

Supply and erection of a metal roof structure of trusses, beams and purlins in rolled or cold formed sections, with welded or bolted connections and an anti-corrosion primer. Includes checking the bearings and the base plates, hoisting and offering up the members, temporary bracing during erection, making the final connections, the geometric check of levels and falls and touching up the anti-corrosion protection where it has been affected by welding. Measured by the weight actually erected.
Supply and installation of minor metalwork for a canopy, with welded sections. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a roof. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a lightweight intermediate floor. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a stair. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a canopy. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a mezzanine. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a lightweight roof. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork. Includes hoisting, erection and bolting. Measured per kilogram erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de forro de placa d: Supply and lining installation of board of reinforced cement with fiber on metal structure, for areas damp and premises expuestos to salpicaduras. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the screwing of the board with screws apropiados, the joint treatment with mesh and the junction sealing. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation of board of reinforced cement with fiber on structure, as substrate of the tiling in shower area or bathtub. Includes the structure, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment with mesh and the sealing of the joints prior to the waterproofing and the tiling. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation of gypsum board of 12,5 mm on battens fixed to the wall, creating to chamber minimum for the passage of installations. Includes the fastening of the battens to plumb with plugs, the passage of the installations by the chamber, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de forro ignífugo d: Supply and lining installation fire-resistant of gypsum board resistant to the fire of 15 mm, on metal structure, for protection of installations, ducts or structure. Includes the structure, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment and the sealing of the steps of installations. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de interruptor dife: Supply and installation of residual current device of high sensibilidad in the board, with its connection and test. Es the device that protects to the personas face to the electrical contact: the thermomagnetics protegen the installation, no to quien the toca. Its installation es required in circuits of bathrooms, kitchens and exterior. Includes the installation on rail, the wiring of phases and neutral observing the orden, the checking of that no neutral of the circuit protected is joined waters below with other circuit, error that causes trippings intermitentes imposibles of diagnosticar, and the test with the button of test and with dimension unit. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de interruptor term: Supply and switch installation thermomagnetic in the board, with its connection and identification. The capacity of the switch must corresponder to the gauge of the conductor that protects, no to the consumption of the unit: to switch oversized protect leaves the cable and it convierte in the fusible of the circuit. Includes the installation on rail, the connection of phase and its tightening to the pair, the labeling of the circuit in the panel schedule and the tripping test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de llave de paso de: Supply and valve installation of passage of esfera of PPR of 20 mm, recessed in face, for the cutting sectorizado of the water supply. Includes opening of the opening, installation alternating in the pipe by heat fusion, checking of the maniobrabilidad of the volante, watertightness test and patching of the face, leaving the embellecedor flush. Measured per unit installed and tested.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de marco y contrama: Supply and installation of a metal frame and subframe to a door opening, cast into the masonry or anchored to the wall. The subframe is placed as the wall is built and ends up cast in, so its setting out and plumb condition all the joinery that follows: a subframe that is out of plumb cannot be put right afterwards. Includes setting out, plumbing with temporary bracing, bedding the fixing lugs into the masonry, the anti-corrosion protection and fitting the final frame. Measured by the perimeter length of the opening.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de pasamanos de mad: Supply and installation of a wood handrail over an existing guardrail or directly onto a wall on brackets. Includes setting out a constant height following the pitch of the stair, cutting and joining the lengths with hidden joints, fitting the brackets at the spacing that avoids flexing, fixing the handrail, sanding the joint until it cannot be felt, which is how a handrail is judged, and varnishing. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de placa de yeso la: Supply and installation of gypsum board of 12,5 mm on battens to level to wall and conceal installations exposed without recurrir to construction site damp. Includes the field layout, the fastening of the battens, the passage and protection of the installations, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of face leveled.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de portón corredizo: Supply and installation of a metal sliding gate for vehicular or pedestrian access, with its frame, track, wheels, guides and stops. Includes fabricating or taking delivery of the frame, constructing or checking that the running track is perfectly level, since any unevenness makes the gate run by itself or jam, fitting the wheels and the top guides, adjusting the travel and the stops, the anti-corrosion primer and checking the operation. Measured by the area actually carried out.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de protector contra: Supply and protective installation against overvoltage transient type 1 (class I) in the board main, with its connection to earth. Includes the choice of the modelo according to the corriente of discharge foreseen, the installation in the carril of the board, the connection of the conductors of phase, neutral and earth with the section indicated and it more cortos possible, and the operation test. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and protective installation against overvoltage transient type 2 (class II) in board secundario of distribution, with its connection to earth. Includes the installation in the carril of the board, the connection of the conductors with the section indicated and it more cortos possible, and the operation test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de puerta corrediza: Supply and installation of a sliding closet door with its top and bottom tracks, carriers, door leaves and pulls. Includes leveling the top track, which carries the weight and on which it depends that the leaves neither drop nor drag, fitting the bottom guide, hanging the leaves on their adjustable carriers, adjusting the verticality and the overlap between leaves and fitting the stops and brush seals. Measured by the area actually carried out.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de rampa metálica e: Supply and erection of a structural steel ramp. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de tablero eléctric: Supply and board installation electrical with protections. Includes the installation and the connection. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and board installation electrical of recessed distribution or surface-mounted, with its barraje of neutral and earth, and reserve space for extensions. Includes the field layout in point accessible and no blocked, the opening of the opening and the installation flush, the entrance tidy of the conduits, the installation of the barraje, the connection of the circuits with the conductor peinado and identificado, the installation of the panel schedule of circuits labeling, that es what allows to any localizar to failure without ir testing, and the continuity test and insulation. Measured per board installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de tragante, boquil: Supply and installation of a roof drain with its leaf guard, integrated into the waterproofing. Includes forming the recess at the low point, placing the unit with its flange embedded between the layers of waterproofing, sealing the junction, fitting the grate and checking the discharge with a water test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de trasdosado autop: Supply and lining installation self-supporting with double gypsum board of 12,5 mm, for increase the acoustic mass and the strength to the impact. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the screwing of the two boards with joints alternadas, the joint treatment in both layers and the junction finishing. Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board with reinforcement interior of lumber or metal profile, for the subsequent anchorage of loadings as cabinets hungs, televisores or shelvings. Includes the structure, the installation of the reinforcement in the position foreseen for the loadings, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board of 12,5 mm with panel of mineral wool of 60 mm in the chamber, for thermal insulation and acoustic. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board of high hardness of 12,5 mm, for faces sometidos to impact and areas of traffic as corridors and common areas. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board standard of 12,5 mm, on steel structure galvanized separate of the wall, without insulation. Includes the field layout of the structure with each studs 60 cm, the fastening of start channels to the floor and to the ceiling with perimeter band of watertightness, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment with compound and tape, and the junction finishing with walls and ceiling. Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board resistant to the damp of 12,5 mm, for bathrooms, kitchens and premises with condensation. Includes the perimeter band, the installation of the panel, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

cadenas.Suministro, corte, doblado, armado y col: Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement of 4,200 kg/cm² yield strength to columns, to the bending schedules. Output per kilogram is among the lowest of any reinforcement on site because of the vertical work and the number of stirrups. Includes cutting and bending the bars and stirrups, assembling the cage at the stirrup spacing indicated and closing it up in the confinement zones at the ends, tying with wire at every intersection, lapping with the starter bars from the footing or the level below at the specified lap length, placing spacers on all four faces and plumbing and bracing the cage before the formwork. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement of 4,200 kg/cm² yield strength to footings and foundation bases, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending on site or taking delivery of the steel pre-bent, assembling the mats tied with wire at every intersection around the perimeter and at alternate intersections within, placing spacers to give the specified cover on every face, bracing the cage so that it cannot move during the pour and checking the schedule before the concrete is authorized. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed, excluding offcuts and laps not allowed for in the schedule.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a reinforced concrete stair, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the main mat of the inclined slab with its distribution steel, placing the reinforcement at the breaks in the geometry where the line of the steel must follow the direction of the tension, anchoring at the bearings at the foot and the head, tying with wire and placing spacers. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a mat foundation, in top and bottom mats to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the mats with wire ties, placing bottom spacers and the chairs or supports that hold the top mat at its level during the pour, the edge and corner reinforcement, and checking the schedule and the cover before the concrete is authorized. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a solid slab, in top and bottom mats to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the mats with wire ties, placing bottom spacers and the chairs that hold the top mat at its level, the reinforcement over the supports and around the edges of openings, and going over the position of the cage immediately before the pour. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a retaining wall, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the two vertical mats with their starter hooks lapped to the starter bars from the footing, tying with wire, placing spacers on both faces to give the cover, the edge and corner reinforcement, and checking that the mat on the earth side falls on the correct tension face, a frequent error with serious consequences. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement in two vertical mats to a structural concrete wall, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling both mats with their vertical and horizontal bars, placing the tie hooks or chairs between the mats that stop them spreading during the pour, lapping with the starter bars from the level below, placing the edge reinforcement and the confinement elements at the ends, placing spacers on both faces and checking the schedule. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to tie beams, to the bending schedules. Beam reinforcement takes longer per kilogram than footing reinforcement because of the stirrups and the work in a narrow trench. Includes cutting and bending the bars and stirrups, assembling the cage at the stirrup spacing indicated and closing it up in the confinement zones next to the bearings, tying with wire, placing spacers on all four faces, anchoring or lapping with the starter bars from the footings and checking the schedule before the pour. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to beams, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending the bars and stirrups, assembling the cage at the stirrup spacing indicated and closing it up in the confinement zones next to the supports, placing the top steel over the supports and the bottom steel at mid span in accordance with the bending moment diagram, tying with wire, placing spacers, anchoring into the joints with the columns and checking the schedule before the pour is authorized. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of the reinforcement cage of the pile, with its longitudinal bars and its helical tie. Includes assembling the cage at the surface, fitting circular spacers that center the cage in the bore and give the cover, hoisting and lowering the cage under control into the pile without it scraping the sides and dragging in soil, suspending it at the correct level during the pour and forming the starter bars for the connection to the pile cap. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.
cadenas.Suministro, instalación y configuración: Supply, installation and initial configuration of the central home automation or controlador main, with its source of supply and its connection to the red local. It does not include anti-corrosion protection or fire protection. Measured by the weight of steelwork actually erected.

cadenas.Traslado del mobiliario y enseres del cl: Removal of the client's furniture and belongings from the work area to a storage room within the same building, protected, and returned when the work is finished. cadenas.Traslado interno y acopio provisional en: Internal movement and temporary stockpiling on site of excavated material suitable for reuse in the later backfill, avoiding the double cost of tipping it and then buying imported fill. Measured by the volume of material actually stockpiled.
